items.source:
--[[
MAD STUDIO

-[Replica]---------------------------------------
	
	State replication with life cycle handling and individual client subscription control.
	
	WARNING: Avoid numeric tables with gaps & non string/numeric keys - They can't be replicated!
			
	Members:
	
		Replica.ReadyPlayers          [table] -- (read-only) {[player] = true, ...}
		Replica.NewReadyPlayer        [Signal] (player)
		Replica.RemovingReadyPlayer   [Signal] (player)
	
	Functions:
	
		Replica.Token(token_string) --> [ReplicaToken] -- Only one token object can be created for each unique "token_string"
	
		Replica.New(params) --> [Replica]
			params   [table]:
				{
					Token = [ReplicaToken],
					-- Optional:
					Tags = {}, -- Immutable dictionary meant for identifying the Replica (e.g. UserId = 2312310)
					Data = {}, -- Initial replica state
					WriteLib = ModuleScript,
				}
		
		Replica.FromId(id) --> [Replica] or nil
		
	Members [Replica]:
	
		Replica.Tags             [table] Secondary Replica identifiers
		Replica.Data             [table] (Read only) Table which is replicated
		
		Replica.Id               [number] Unique identifier
		Replica.Token            [string] Primary Replica identifier
		
		Replica.Parent           [Replica] or nil
		Replica.Children         [table]: {[replica] = true, ...}
		
		Replica.BoundInstance    [Instance] or nil
		
		Replica.OnServerEvent    [Signal] (player, ...)
		
		Replica.Maid             [Maid]
	
	Methods [Component]:
	
		-- [path]: {"Players", 2312310, "Health"} -- A path defines a key branch within Replica.Data
	
		Replica:Set(path, value)
		Replica:SetValues(path, values)
			values   [table]: {key = value, ...}
			
		Replica:TableInsert(path, value, index?) --> new_index -- Performs table.insert(path, value)
		Replica:TableRemove(path, index) --> removed_value -- Performs table.remove(path, index)
		
		Replica:Write(function_name, ...) --> ... -- Run WriteLib function with given parameters
		
		Replica:FireClient(player, ...) -- Will not replicate to unsubscribed players
		Replica:FireAllClients(...) -- Will not replicate to unsubscribed players
		Replica:UFireClient(player, ...) -- Same as "Replica:FireClient()", but using UnreliableRemoteEvent
		Replica:UFireAllClients(...) -- Same as "Replica:FireAllClients()", but using UnreliableRemoteEvent
		
		Replica:SetParent(replica) -- Replication will be inherited from parent replica; Replication and bind methods will be locked.
		
		Replica:BindToInstance(instance) -- Players who observe the instance stream in
			-- will be subscribed to this component; Observing the instance stream out
			-- will destroy the component for the observing player; Replicas should be bound
			-- to instances first and then ":Replicate()" or ":Subscribe()" should be called
			-- after. A replica can only be bound once.
			
		Replica:Replicate() -- Subscribes all existing and future players; ":Subscribe()" and ":Unsubscribe()" will become locked
		Replica:DontReplicate() -- Resets all previous subscription settings;
		Replica:Subscribe(player) -- Replicates to player; WILL NOT subscribe to players that are not ready & will throw a warning for trying to do so.
		Replica:Unsubscribe(player) -- Destroys Replica for player
		
		Replica:Identify() --> [string] -- Debug

		Replica:IsActive() --> [bool]
		
		Replica:Destroy() -- Destroys replica and all of its descendants (Depth-first)
	
--]]

----- Dependencies -----

local ReplicaShared = game.ReplicatedStorage.ReplicaShared
local RateLimit = require(ReplicaShared.RateLimit)
local Remote = require(ReplicaShared.Remote)
local Signal = require(ReplicaShared.Signal)
local Maid = require(ReplicaShared.Maid)

----- Private -----

local BIND_TAG = "Bind"
local CS_TAG = "REPLICA" -- CollectionService tag
local REPLICATION_ALL = "ALL"
local MAID_LOCK = {}
local EMPTY_TABLE = {}

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local GlobalRateLimit = RateLimit.New(120)

local ReadyPlayers: {[Player]: boolean} = {}

local Replicas = {} -- [id] = Replica, ...
local TopReplicas = {} -- [Replica] = true, ... -- Replicas with active subsciption settings
local ReplicationAllReplicas = {} -- [Replica] = true, ... -- Replicas that had the method :Replicate() called on them
local SelectiveSubscriptions = {} -- [Player] = {[replica] = true, ...}

local RemoteRequestData = Remote.New("ReplicaRequestData") -- Fired client-side when the client loads for the first time

local RemoteSet = Remote.New("ReplicaSet")                 -- (replica_id, path, value)
local RemoteSetValues = Remote.New("ReplicaSetValues")     -- (replica_id, path, values)
local RemoteTableInsert = Remote.New("ReplicaTableInsert") -- (replica_id, path, value, index)
local RemoteTableRemove = Remote.New("ReplicaTableRemove") -- (replica_id, path, index)
local RemoteWrite = Remote.New("ReplicaWrite")             -- (replica_id, fn_id, ...)
local RemoteSignal = Remote.New("ReplicaSignal")           -- (replica_id, ...)
local RemoteParent = Remote.New("ReplicaParent")           -- (replica_id, parent_id)
local RemoteCreate = Remote.New("ReplicaCreate")           -- (creation, root_id?) or ({creation, ...})
local RemoteBind = Remote.New("ReplicaBind")               -- (replica_id)
local RemoteDestroy = Remote.New("ReplicaDestroy")         -- (replica_id)
local RemoteSignalUnreliable = Remote.New("ReplicaSignalUnreliable", true)   -- (replica_id, ...)

local Index = 0

local WriteLibCache: {[ModuleScript]: {[string | number]: {Id: number, fn: (...any) -> (...any)}}} = {}
local WriteFlag = false
local Tokens: {[string]: boolean} = {}
local TokenValidate = {}

local BindValuePrefab = Instance.new("NumberValue")
BindValuePrefab.Name = "ReplicaBind"
CollectionService:AddTag(BindValuePrefab, CS_TAG)

local function IterateGroup(replica, fn) -- fn(replica)
	fn(replica)
	for child in pairs(replica.Children) do
		IterateGroup(child, fn)
	end
end

local function LoadWriteLib(module: ModuleScript)

	local write_lib = WriteLibCache[module]

	if write_lib ~= nil then
		return write_lib -- WriteLib module was previously loaded
	end

	if typeof(module) ~= "Instance" or module:IsA("ModuleScript") ~= true then
		error(`[{script.Name}]: "WriteLib" is not a ModuleScript`)
	elseif module:IsDescendantOf(ReplicatedStorage) == false then
		error(`[{script.Name}]: "WriteLib" module must be a descendant of ReplicatedStorage`)
	end

	local loaded_module = require(module)

	if type(loaded_module) ~= "table" then
		error(`[{script.Name}]: A "WriteLib" ModuleScript must return a table`)
	end

	local function_list = {} -- fn_id = {fn_name, fn}

	for key, value in pairs(loaded_module) do
		if type(key) ~= "string" then
			error(`[{script.Name}]: "WriteLib" table keys must be strings`)
		elseif type(value) ~= "function" then
			error(`[{script.Name}]: "WriteLib" table values must be functions`)
		end
		table.insert(function_list, {key, value})
	end

	table.sort(function_list, function(item1, item2)
		return item1[1] < item2[1] -- Sort functions by their names - this creates a consistent indexing on server and client-side
	end)

	write_lib = {} -- {["fn_name" | fn_id] = {Id = fn_id, fn = fn}, ...}

	for fn_id, fn_entry in ipairs(function_list) do
		local entry_table = {Id = fn_id, fn = fn_entry[2]}
		write_lib[fn_entry[1]] = entry_table
		write_lib[fn_id] = entry_table
	end

	WriteLibCache[module] = write_lib

	return write_lib

end

function GenerateCreation(replica)
	local replication = {}
	local creation = {}
	IterateGroup(replica, function(group_replica)
		local self_creation = group_replica.self_creation
		self_creation[4] = if group_replica.Parent == nil then 0 else group_replica.Parent.Id
		creation[tostring(group_replica.Id)] = self_creation
		group_replica.creation = creation
		group_replica.replication = replication
	end)
end

----- Public -----

export type Replica = {
	Tags: {[any]: any},
	Data: {[any]: any},
	Id: number,
	Token: string,
	Parent: Replica?,
	Children: {[Replica]: boolean?},
	BoundInstance: Instance?,
	OnServerEvent: {Connect: (self: any, listener: (Player, ...any) -> ()) -> ({Disconnect: (self: any) -> ()})},
	Maid: typeof(Maid),

	Set: (self: any, path: {string}, value: any) -> (),
	SetValues: (self: any, path: {string}, values: {[string]: any}) -> (),
	TableInsert: (self: any, path: {string}, value: any, index: number?) -> (number),
	TableRemove: (self: any, path: {string}, index: number) -> (any),
	Write: (self: any, function_name: string, ...any) -> (...any),
	FireClient: (self: any, player: Player, ...any) -> (),
	FireAllClients: (self: any, ...any) -> (),
	UFireClient: (self: any, player: Player, ...any) -> (),
	UFireAllClients: (self: any, ...any) -> (),
	SetParent: (self: any, new_parent: Replica) -> (),
	BindToInstance: (self: any, instance: Instance) -> (),
	Replicate: (self: any) -> (),
	DontReplicate: (self: any) -> (),
	Subscribe: (self: any, player: Player) -> (),
	Unsubscribe: (self: any, player: Player) -> (),
	Identify: (self: any) -> (string),
	IsActive: (self: any) -> (boolean),
	Destroy: (self: any) -> (),
}

local Replica = {
	ReadyPlayers = ReadyPlayers,
	NewReadyPlayer = Signal.New(),
	RemovingReadyPlayer = Signal.New(),
}
Replica.__index = Replica

local ReplicaToken = {}
ReplicaToken.__index = ReplicaToken

local LockedReplica = {}
LockedReplica.__index = LockedReplica

function Replica.Token(name: string)

	if type(name) ~= "string" then
		error(`[{script.Name}]: name must be a string`)
	end

	if Tokens[name] == true then
		--error(`[{script.Name}]: Token "{name}" duplicate`)

		for token, _ in pairs(TokenValidate) do
			if token.Name == name then
				return token
			end
		end

	end

	Tokens[name] = true

	local self = setmetatable({
		Name = name,
	}, ReplicaToken)

	TokenValidate[self] = true

	return self

end

function Replica.New(params: {Token: typeof(ReplicaToken), Tags: {}?, Data: {}?, WriteLib: ModuleScript?}): Replica

	local token = params.Token
	local tags = params.Tags or {}
	local data = params.Data or {}
	local write_lib = nil

	if TokenValidate[token] == nil then
		error(`[{script.Name}]: "Token" is not valid ({tostring(token)})`)
	elseif type(tags) ~= "table" then
		error(`[{script.Name}]: "Tags" is not a table`)
	elseif type(data) ~= "table" then
		error(`[{script.Name}]: "Data" is not a table`)
	elseif tags[BIND_TAG] ~= nil then
		error(`[{script.Name}]: "Tags.{BIND_TAG}" key is reserved`)
	end

	if params.WriteLib ~= nil then
		write_lib = LoadWriteLib(params.WriteLib)
	end

	Index += 1

	local self = setmetatable({
		Tags = tags,
		Data = data,
		Id = Index,
		Token = token.Name,
		Parent = nil,
		Children = {},
		BoundInstance = nil,
		OnServerEvent = Signal.New(),
		Maid = Maid.New(MAID_LOCK),

		self_creation = {token.Name, tags, data, 0, params.WriteLib},
		creation = nil, -- ["replica_id"] = {token, tags, data, parent_id, write_lib}, ...	
		replication = nil, -- {REPLICATION_ALL = true} or {[Player] = true, ...}

		write_lib = write_lib,
		write_lib_module = params.WriteLib,
		bind_value = nil,

	}, Replica)

	Replicas[Index] = self

	return self

end

function Replica.FromId(id: number): Replica
	return Replicas[id]
end

function Replica.Test()
	return {
		Replicas = Replicas, -- [id] = Replica, ...
		TopReplicas = TopReplicas, -- [Replica] = true, ... -- Replicas with active subsciption settings
		ReplicationAllReplicas = ReplicationAllReplicas, -- [Replica] = true, ... -- Replicas that had the method :Replicate() called on them
		SelectiveSubscriptions = SelectiveSubscriptions, -- [Player] = {[replica] = true, ...}
	}
end

function Replica:Set(path: {string}, value: any)

	-- Apply local change:

	local pointer = self.Data
	for i = 1, #path - 1 do
		pointer = pointer[path[i]]
	end
	pointer[path[#path]] = value

	-- Replicate change:

	if WriteFlag == false then
		local self_id = self.Id
		if self.replication ~= nil then
			if self.replication[REPLICATION_ALL] == true then
				for player in pairs(ReadyPlayers) do
					RemoteSet:FireClient(player, self_id, path, value)
				end
			else
				for player in pairs(self.replication) do
					RemoteSet:FireClient(player, self_id, path, value)
				end
			end
		end
	end

end

function Replica:SetValues(path: {string}, values: {[string]: any})

	-- Apply local change:

	local pointer = self.Data
	for _, key in ipairs(path) do
		pointer = pointer[key]
	end
	for key, value in pairs(values) do
		pointer[key] = value
	end

	-- Replicate change:

	if WriteFlag == false then
		local self_id = self.Id
		if self.replication ~= nil then
			if self.replication[REPLICATION_ALL] == true then
				for player in pairs(ReadyPlayers) do
					RemoteSetValues:FireClient(player, self_id, path, values)
				end
			else
				for player in pairs(self.replication) do
					RemoteSetValues:FireClient(player, self_id, path, values)
				end
			end
		end
	end

end

function Replica:TableInsert(path: {string}, value: any, index: number?): number

	-- Apply local change:

	local pointer = self.Data
	for _, key in ipairs(path) do
		pointer = pointer[key]
	end
	if index ~= nil then
		table.insert(pointer, index, value)
	else
		table.insert(pointer, value)
	end

	-- Replicate change:

	if WriteFlag == false then
		local self_id = self.Id
		if self.replication ~= nil then
			if self.replication[REPLICATION_ALL] == true then
				for player in pairs(ReadyPlayers) do
					RemoteTableInsert:FireClient(player, self_id, path, value, index)
				end
			else
				for player in pairs(self.replication) do
					RemoteTableInsert:FireClient(player, self_id, path, value, index)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return index or #pointer

end

function Replica:TableRemove(path: {string}, index: number): any

	-- Apply local change:

	local pointer = self.Data
	for _, key in ipairs(path) do
		pointer = pointer[key]
	end
	local removed_value = table.remove(pointer, index)

	-- Replicate change:

	if WriteFlag == false then
		local self_id = self.Id
		if self.replication ~= nil then
			if self.replication[REPLICATION_ALL] == true then
				for player in pairs(ReadyPlayers) do
					RemoteTableRemove:FireClient(player, self_id, path, index)
				end
			else
				for player in pairs(self.replication) do
					RemoteTableRemove:FireClient(player, self_id, path, index)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return removed_value

end

function Replica:Write(function_name: string, ...): ...any

	local write_lib_entry = self.write_lib[function_name]

	if WriteFlag == true then -- Chained :Write()
		return write_lib_entry.fn(self, ...)
	end

	-- Apply local change:

	WriteFlag = true
	local return_params = table.pack(pcall(write_lib_entry.fn, self, ...))
	WriteFlag = false

	if return_params[1] ~= true then
		error(`[{script.Name}]: (WriteLib) ` .. tostring(return_params[2]))
	end

	table.remove(return_params, 1)

	-- Replicate change:

	local self_id = self.Id
	local fn_id = write_lib_entry.Id

	if self.replication ~= nil then
		if self.replication[REPLICATION_ALL] == true then
			for player in pairs(ReadyPlayers) do
				RemoteWrite:FireClient(player, self_id, fn_id, ...)
			end
		else
			for player in pairs(self.replication) do
				RemoteWrite:FireClient(player, self_id, fn_id, ...)
			end
		end
	end

	return table.unpack(return_params)

end

function Replica:FireClient(player, ...)
	if self.replication ~= nil then
		if (self.replication[REPLICATION_ALL] == true and ReadyPlayers[player] == true) or self.replication[player] ~= nil then
			RemoteSignal:FireClient(player, self.Id, ...)
		end
	end
end

function Replica:FireAllClients(...)
	local self_id = self.Id
	if self.replication ~= nil then
		if self.replication[REPLICATION_ALL] == true then
			for player in pairs(ReadyPlayers) do
				RemoteSignal:FireClient(player, self_id, ...)
			end
		else
			for player in pairs(self.replication) do
				RemoteSignal:FireClient(player, self_id, ...)
			end
		end
	end
end

function Replica:UFireClient(player, ...)
	if self.replication ~= nil then
		if (self.replication[REPLICATION_ALL] == true and ReadyPlayers[player] == true) or self.replication[player] ~= nil then
			RemoteSignalUnreliable:FireClient(player, self.Id, ...)
		end
	end
end

function Replica:UFireAllClients(...)
	local self_id = self.Id
	if self.replication ~= nil then
		if self.replication[REPLICATION_ALL] == true then
			for player in pairs(ReadyPlayers) do
				RemoteSignalUnreliable:FireClient(player, self_id, ...)
			end
		else
			for player in pairs(self.replication) do
				RemoteSignalUnreliable:FireClient(player, self_id, ...)
			end
		end
	end
end

function Replica:SetParent(new_parent)

	if type(new_parent) ~= "table" or getmetatable(new_parent) ~= Replica then
		error(`[{script.Name}]: new_parent is not a Replica ({tostring(new_parent)})`)
	elseif Replicas[new_parent.Id] == nil then
		error(`[{script.Name}]: Can't set destroyed Replica as parent`)
	end

	-- Top Replica / Bind check:

	if TopReplicas[self] ~= nil then
		error(`[{script.Name}]: Can't change parent for top level Replica`)
	end

	if self.BoundInstance ~= nil then
		error(`[{script.Name}]: Can't change parent for bound Replica`)
	end

	-- Recursion check:

	local recursion_check = new_parent

	while recursion_check ~= nil do
		recursion_check = recursion_check.Parent
		if recursion_check == self then
			error(`[{script.Name}]: Can't set descendant Replica as parent`)
		end
	end

	-- Hierarchy:

	local old_parent = self.Parent

	if old_parent == new_parent then
		return
	end

	self.Parent = new_parent

	if old_parent ~= nil then
		old_parent.Children[self] = nil
	end

	new_parent.Children[self] = true

	-- Altering creation and replication tables:

	IterateGroup(self, function(group_replica)
		local string_id = tostring(group_replica.Id)
		if old_parent ~= nil and old_parent.creation ~= nil then
			old_parent.creation[string_id] = nil
		end
		if new_parent.creation ~= nil then
			local self_creation = group_replica.self_creation
			self_creation[4] = group_replica.Parent.Id
			new_parent.creation[string_id] = self_creation
		end
		group_replica.creation = new_parent.creation
		group_replica.replication = new_parent.replication
	end)

	-- Subscriptions:

	local self_id = self.Id
	local parent_id = new_parent.Id
	local parent_creation = new_parent.creation

	local old_subscriptions = EMPTY_TABLE

	if old_parent ~= nil and old_parent.replication ~= nil then
		if old_parent.replication[REPLICATION_ALL] == true then
			old_subscriptions = ReadyPlayers
		else
			old_subscriptions = old_parent.replication
		end
	end

	local new_subscriptions = EMPTY_TABLE

	if new_parent ~= nil and new_parent.replication ~= nil then
		if new_parent.replication[REPLICATION_ALL] == true then
			new_subscriptions = ReadyPlayers
		else
			new_subscriptions = new_parent.replication
		end
	end

	-- Informing clients who lost subscription to replica group:

	if old_parent ~= nil and old_parent.replication ~= nil then
		if new_parent.replication ~= old_parent.replication and new_subscriptions ~= ReadyPlayers then

			for player in pairs(old_subscriptions) do
				if new_subscriptions[player] == nil then
					RemoteDestroy:FireClient(player, self_id)
				end
			end

		end
	end

	-- Informing clients who gained subscription to replica group / who retained the subscription:

	if new_parent.replication ~= nil then

		local custom_creation

		for player in pairs(new_subscriptions) do

			if old_subscriptions[player] == true then
				RemoteParent:FireClient(player, self_id, parent_id) -- Subscription was retained
			else
				if custom_creation == nil then -- Generating custom_creation if at least one new subscription was made
					custom_creation = {}
					IterateGroup(self, function(group_replica)
						local string_id = tostring(group_replica.Id)
						custom_creation[string_id] = parent_creation[string_id]
					end)
				end
				RemoteCreate:FireClient(player, custom_creation, self_id)
			end

		end

	end

end

function Replica:BindToInstance(instance: Instance)

	if typeof(instance) ~= "Instance" then
		error(`[{script.Name}]: "instance" argument is not an Instance ({tostring(instance)})`)
	end

	if self.Parent ~= nil then
		error(`[{script.Name}]: Can't bind Replica parented to another Replica`)
	end

	if self.BoundInstance ~= nil then
		error(`[{script.Name}]: Can't change Replica bind to another Instance`)
	end

	if instance:IsA("Model") == true and (instance.ModelStreamingMode == Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Default or instance.ModelStreamingMode == Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Nonatomic) then
		warn(`[{script.Name}]: Bound Replica to a model that has inproper "ModelStreamingMode" setup; Traceback:\n` .. debug.traceback())
	end

	local bind_value = BindValuePrefab:Clone()
	bind_value.Value = self.Id

	self.Tags[BIND_TAG] = true
	self.BoundInstance = instance
	self.bind_value = bind_value

	bind_value.Parent = instance

	local self_id = self.Id
	if self.replication ~= nil then
		if self.replication[REPLICATION_ALL] == true then
			for player in pairs(ReadyPlayers) do
				RemoteBind:FireClient(player, self_id)
			end
		else
			for player in pairs(self.replication) do
				RemoteBind:FireClient(player, self_id)
			end
		end
	end

end

function Replica:Replicate()

	if self.Parent ~= nil then
		error(`[{script.Name}]: Can't selectively replicate Replica parented to another Replica`)
	end

	if self.creation == nil then
		GenerateCreation(self)
		TopReplicas[self] = true
	elseif self.replication[REPLICATION_ALL] == true then
		return
	end

	local creation = self.creation
	local replication = self.replication

	for player in pairs(ReadyPlayers) do
		if replication[player] == nil then
			RemoteCreate:FireClient(player, creation)
		else
			local selective_lookup = SelectiveSubscriptions[player]
			selective_lookup[self] = nil
		end
	end

	table.clear(replication)
	replication[REPLICATION_ALL] = true
	ReplicationAllReplicas[self] = true

end

function Replica:DontReplicate()

	if self.Parent ~= nil then
		error(`[{script.Name}]: Can't selectively replicate Replica parented to another Replica`)
	end

	local replication = self.replication

	if replication == nil or next(replication) == nil then
		return
	end

	ReplicationAllReplicas[self] = nil

	local self_id = self.Id

	if replication[REPLICATION_ALL] == true then
		for player in pairs(ReadyPlayers) do
			RemoteDestroy:FireClient(player, self_id)
		end
	else
		for player in pairs(replication) do
			RemoteDestroy:FireClient(player, self_id)
			SelectiveSubscriptions[player][self] = nil
		end
	end

	table.clear(replication)

end

function Replica:Subscribe(player: Player)

	if self.Parent ~= nil then
		error(`[{script.Name}]: Can't selectively replicate Replica parented to another Replica`)
	end

	if self.creation == nil then
		GenerateCreation(self)
		TopReplicas[self] = true
	elseif self.replication[REPLICATION_ALL] == true then
		error(`[{script.Name}]: "Subscribe()" is locked after calling "Replicate()"`)
	end

	if ReadyPlayers[player] == nil then
		warn(`[{script.Name}]: Called "Subscribe()" on a non-ready player; Traceback:\n` .. debug.traceback())
		return
	end

	local creation = self.creation
	local replication = self.replication

	if replication[player] ~= nil then
		return -- Already subscribed
	end

	replication[player] = true
	SelectiveSubscriptions[player][self] = true
	RemoteCreate:FireClient(player, creation)

end

function Replica:Unsubscribe(player: Player)

	if self.Parent ~= nil then
		error(`[{script.Name}]: Can't selectively replicate Replica parented to another Replica`)
	end

	local replication = self.replication

	if replication == nil then
		return
	end

	if replication[REPLICATION_ALL] == true then
		error(`[{script.Name}]: "Unsubscribe()" is locked after calling "Replicate()"`)
	end

	if replication[player] ~= nil then
		replication[player] = nil
		SelectiveSubscriptions[player][self] = nil
		RemoteDestroy:FireClient(player, self.Id)
	end

end

function Replica:Identify(): string
	local tag_string = ""
	local first_tag = true
	for key, value in pairs(self.Tags) do
		tag_string ..= `{if first_tag == true then "" else ";"}{tostring(key)}={tostring(value)}`
		first_tag = false
	end
	return `[Id:{self.Id};Token:{self.Token};Tags:\{{tag_string}\}]`
end

function Replica:IsActive(): boolean
	return self.Maid:IsActive()
end

local function DestroyReplica(replica)
	-- Scan children replicas:
	for child in pairs(replica.Children) do
		DestroyReplica(child)
	end

	local id = replica.Id
	-- Clear replica entry:
	Replicas[id] = nil
	-- Cleanup:
	replica.Maid:Unlock(MAID_LOCK)
	replica.Maid:Cleanup()
	-- Bind cleanup:
	if replica.BoundInstance ~= nil then
		replica.BoundInstance = nil
		replica.bind_value:Destroy()
		replica.bind_value = nil
	end
	-- Remove creation data:
	if replica.creation ~= nil then
		replica.creation[tostring(id)] = nil
	end
	-- Swap metatables:
	setmetatable(replica, LockedReplica)
end

function Replica:Destroy()

	Tokens[self.Token] = nil
	TokenValidate[self.Token] = nil

	local self_id = self.Id

	if Replicas[self_id] == nil then
		return
	end

	local is_top = TopReplicas[self] == true

	-- Destroy replica for all clients who were replicated to:

	if self.replication ~= nil then
		if self.replication[REPLICATION_ALL] == true then
			for player in pairs(ReadyPlayers) do
				RemoteDestroy:FireClient(player, self_id)
			end
		else
			for player in pairs(self.replication) do
				RemoteDestroy:FireClient(player, self_id)
				if is_top == true then
					SelectiveSubscriptions[player][self] = nil
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- Clearing hierarchy:

	TopReplicas[self] = nil
	ReplicationAllReplicas[self] = nil

	if self.Parent ~= nil then
		self.Parent.Children[self] = nil
	end

	-- Recursive destruction:

	DestroyReplica(self)

end

----- Init -----

do -- Destroyed replica metatable:

	local keep_methods = {
		Identify = true,
		Destroy = true,
	}

	for name, fn in pairs(Replica) do
		if name ~= "__index" then
			if keep_methods[name] == true then
				LockedReplica[name] = fn
			else
				LockedReplica[name] = function(self)
					error(`[{script.Name}]: Tried to call method "{name}" for a destroyed replica; {self:Identify()}`)
				end
			end
		end
	end

end

-- New player data replication:

RemoteRequestData.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player)

	if ReadyPlayers[player] ~= nil and player:IsDescendantOf(Players) == true then
		return
	end

	-- Make the client create all replicas that are initially replicated to the client;
	-- Pack up and send intially replicated replicas:

	local creation = {}

	for replica in pairs(ReplicationAllReplicas) do
		table.insert(creation, replica.creation)
	end
	RemoteCreate:FireClient(player, creation)

	-- Let the client know that all replica data has been sent:
	RemoteRequestData:FireClient(player)

	-- Set player to active:
	ReadyPlayers[player] = true
	SelectiveSubscriptions[player] = {}
	Replica.NewReadyPlayer:Fire(player)

end)

-- Client-invoked replica signals:

local function RemoteSignalHandle(player: Player, id: number, ...)

	-- Missing player prevention, spam prevention and exploit prevention:
	if ReadyPlayers[player] == nil or GlobalRateLimit:CheckRate(player) == false
		or type(id) ~= "number" then
		return
	end

	local replica = Replicas[id]

	if replica ~= nil then
		if replica.replication ~= nil and (replica.replication[REPLICATION_ALL] == true or replica.replication[player] ~= nil) then
			replica.OnServerEvent:Fire(player, ...)
		end
	end

end

RemoteSignal.OnServerEvent:Connect(RemoteSignalHandle)
RemoteSignalUnreliable.OnServerEvent:Connect(RemoteSignalHandle)

-- Player leave handling:

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)

	if ReadyPlayers[player] == nil then
		return
	end

	-- Remove player from subscription settings:

	for replica in pairs(SelectiveSubscriptions[player]) do
		replica.replication[player] = nil
	end

	-- Remove player from ready players list:

	ReadyPlayers[player] = nil
	SelectiveSubscriptions[player] = nil
	Replica.RemovingReadyPlayer:Fire(player)

end)

return Replica

local PLAYER_COLLISION_GROUP = "Players"

local function SetupPlayerCharacterStuff(player: Player, profile: ProfileStore.Profile)
	local function setUpCharacter(character)
		for _, v in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
			if v:IsA("BasePart") then
				v.CollisionGroup = PLAYER_COLLISION_GROUP
			end
		end
		
		local characterFolder = workspace.Characters
		
		repeat
			character.Parent = characterFolder
			task.wait()
		until character.Parent == characterFolder
		
		character.Parent = characterFolder
		character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = Configuration.PlayerWalkSpeed
	end
	
	local character = player.Character 
	if character then
		task.spawn(function()
			setUpCharacter(character)
		end)
	end
	
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(setUpCharacter)
end

local function OnPlayerProfileLoaded(player: Player, profile: ProfileStore.Profile)
	--if player.Name == "supdoggyDev" then profile.Data = require(script.DATA_TEMPLATE); warn("DATA SAVING IS OFF") end
	--profile.Data = require(script.DATA_TEMPLATE); warn("DATA SAVING IS OFF")
	
	script.leaderstats:Clone().Parent = player
	PlayerDataModule.Meet(player, profile)
	
	--// load inventory
	local shovel = player.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Shovel [Pick up plants]")
local waitForBackpackItemToLoadSoWeAreAbleToGiveThePlayerAllTheirItems = shovel and shovel:FindFirstChild("Handle")
	local inventory = profile.Data.Inventory
	for itemName, itemInfo in inventory do
		if typeof(itemInfo) ~= "table" then
			warn("couldn't give inventory item because saved value isn't a table")
			continue
		end
		
		local itemType = itemInfo.itemType
		if itemType == "seed" then
			local seedName = itemName
			local seedAmount = itemInfo.amount
			
			if seedAmount <= 0 then
				continue
			end
			
			ServerUtils.giveSeedTool(player, seedName, seedAmount)
		elseif itemType == "plant" then
			local plantName = itemInfo.name
			local plantNumber = itemName
			local multiplier = itemInfo.multiplier
			local mutation = itemInfo.mutation
			
			ServerUtils.givePlantTool(player, plantName, plantNumber, mutation, multiplier)
		elseif itemType == "NPC" then
			local npcName = itemInfo.name
			local npcGUID = itemName
			local multiplier = itemInfo.multiplier
			local mutation = itemInfo.mutation
			
			ServerUtils.giveNPCTool(player, npcName, npcGUID, multiplier, mutation)
		end
	end
	
	task.spawn(SetupPlayerCharacterStuff, player, profile)
end

local function PlayerAdded(player: Player)	
	-- Start a profile session for this player's data:
	
	local profile = PlayerStore:StartSessionAsync(`{player.UserId}`, {
		Cancel = function()
			return player.Parent ~= Players
		end,
	})

	-- Handling new profile session or failure to start it:
	if profile ~= nil then

		profile:AddUserId(player.UserId) -- GDPR compliance
		profile:Reconcile() -- Fill in missing variables from PROFILE_TEMPLATE (optional)

		profile.OnSessionEnd:Connect(function()
			PlayerDataModule.Forget(player)
			player:Kick(`Profile session end - Please rejoin`)
		end)

		if player.Parent == Players then

			OnPlayerProfileLoaded(player, profile)
			
		else
			-- The player has left before the profile session started
			profile:EndSession()
		end

	else
		-- This condition should only happen when the Roblox server is shutting down
		player:Kick(`Profile load fail - Please rejoin`)
	end
end

local function PlayerRemoving(player: Player)
	-- unload plot
	local plot = Plot.GetFromOwner(player)
	if plot then
		plot:Destroy()
	end
	
	
	local data = PlayerDataModule.Get(player)
	
	if data and data.Profile ~= nil then
		data.Profile.Data.ExitTimestamp = os.time()
		data.Profile:EndSession()
	end
end

local PlayerSetUp = {}

function PlayerSetUp.init()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		task.spawn(PlayerAdded, player)
	end

	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(PlayerAdded)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(PlayerRemoving)
end

return PlayerSetUp

local PlayerDataModule = {}

local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local ProfileStore 	= require(ServerScriptService.Packages.ProfileStore)
local SignalBank 	= require(ServerScriptService.Modules.SignalBank)
local Replica 		= require(ServerScriptService.Packages.ReplicaServer)
local Promise 		= require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Promise)


local registeredStats = {} :: {[string] : {StatName : string, TransformFunction : ((...any) -> any)? }}

local dataContainer = {} :: { 
	Profile : ProfileStore.Profile; 
	DataReplica : Replica.Replica;
	Set : typeof(Replica.New().Set);
	SetValues : typeof(Replica.New().SetValues);
}


function PlayerDataModule.RegisterStat(statPath: string, statName: string, transformFunc: ((...any) -> any)?)
	if not statName then
		warn(`Attmept to register stat for {statPath} failed. parameter "statName" is nil`)
		return
	end

	local entry = {}
	entry.StatName = statName
	entry.TransformFunction = transformFunc
	registeredStats[statPath] = entry
end

function PlayerDataModule.Meet(player: Player, profile: ProfileStore.Profile)
	local leaderstats = player:WaitForChild("leaderstats")

	local dataReplica = Replica.New({
		Token = Replica.Token('PERSISTENT_DATA_REPLICA');
		Tags = {
			Player = player;
		};
		Data = profile.Data;
	})

	local sesisonData = { }
	local sessionDataReplica = Replica.New({
		Token = Replica.Token('SESSION_DATA_REPLICA');
		Tags = {
			Player = player;
		};
		Data = sesisonData;
	})

	local container;
	container = {
		Profile = profile;
		DataReplica = dataReplica;

		SessionData = sesisonData;
		SessionDataReplica = sessionDataReplica;

		UpdateLeaderstat = function(statName: string, value: any)
			leaderstats:FindFirstChild(statName).Value = value
		end;

		Set = function(arg1, ...)
			local path: {string}, value: any

			if arg1 == container then
				path, value = ...
			else
				path, value = arg1, ...
			end

			local ret = dataReplica:Set(path, value)

			local stringPath = table.concat(path, '.')
			local statEntry = registeredStats[stringPath]
			if statEntry then
				local statValue = value
				local statName = statEntry.StatName

				if not statName then
					warn(`Stat registered for "{stringPath}" has no StatName.`)
				else
					local transform = statEntry.TransformFunction

					if transform then
						local success, result = pcall(transform, statValue)
						if success then
							statValue = result
						else
							warn(`Stat registered as "{statEntry.StatName}" transform function error: {result} | {debug.traceback()}`)
						end
					end

					container.UpdateLeaderstat(statEntry.StatName, statValue)
				end
			end

			return ret
		end :: typeof(dataReplica.Set),

		SetValues = function(arg1, ...)
			local path: {string}, values: {[string] : any}

			if arg1 == container then
				path, values = ...
			else
				path, values = arg1, ...
			end

			local ret = dataReplica:SetValues(path, values)

			for valKey, valValue in pairs(values) do
				local strPath = `{table.concat(path, '.')}.{valKey}`
				local statEntry = registeredStats[strPath]
				if statEntry then
					local statValue = valValue
					local statName = statEntry.StatName

					if not statName then
						warn(`Stat registered for "{strPath}" has no StatName.`)
					else
						local transform = statEntry.TransformFunction

						if transform then
							local success, result = pcall(transform, statValue)
							if success then
								statValue = result
							else
								warn(`Stat registered as "{statEntry.StatName}" transform function error: {result} | {debug.traceback()}`)
							end
						end

						container.UpdateLeaderstat(statEntry.StatName, statValue)
					end
				end
			end

			return ret
		end :: typeof(dataReplica.SetValues),
	}

	task.spawn(function()
		while not Replica.ReadyPlayers[player] do
			Replica.NewReadyPlayer:Wait()
		end

		dataReplica:Subscribe(player)
		sessionDataReplica:Subscribe(player)
	end)

	dataContainer[player] = container

	for statPath, statInfo in pairs(registeredStats) do
		local statName = statInfo.StatName
		local statValue = profile.Data

		for _, key in ipairs(statPath:split('.')) do
			statValue = statValue[key]
		end

		local transform = statInfo.TransformFunction
		if transform then
			statValue = transform(statValue)
		end

		container.UpdateLeaderstat(statName, statValue)
	end 

	SignalBank.PLAYER_DATA_LOADED:Fire(player, container)

end

function PlayerDataModule.Forget(player: Player)
	if not dataContainer[player] then 
		warn(`player not in data container.`, dataContainer)
		return 
	end

	dataContainer[player].DataReplica:Destroy()
	dataContainer[player] = nil
end

function PlayerDataModule.Get(player: Player)  : PlayerData?
	return dataContainer[player]
end

function PlayerDataModule.WaitFor(player: Player, timeout: number?) : PlayerData
	if typeof(timeout) ~= 'number' then
		local iyWarningThread = task.delay(5, function()
			warn(`Infinite yield possible within PlayerDataModule.WaitFor(player={player}). Traceback: {debug.traceback()}`)
		end)

		while not dataContainer[player] do
			SignalBank.PLAYER_DATA_LOADED:Wait()
		end

		task.cancel(iyWarningThread)

		return dataContainer[player]
	end

	local retrieved = false
	local data

	local retrieval = Promise.new(function(resolve)
		while not dataContainer[player] do
			SignalBank.PLAYER_DATA_LOADED:Wait()
		end

		retrieved = true
		data = dataContainer[player]

		resolve()
	end)

	local timeout = Promise.delay(timeout)

	Promise.race({retrieval, timeout}):await()

	return retrieved and data
end


export type PlayerData = {
	Profile : ProfileStore.Profile;
	
	DataReplica : Replica.Replica;
	
	SessionData : {};
	SessionDataReplica : Replica.Replica;
	
	Inventory : Inventory.InventoryObject;

	Set 		: typeof(Replica.New().Set);
	SetValues 	: typeof(Replica.New().SetValues);
};

return PlayerDataModule

local PlotService = {}


local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local plotFolder = workspace.Map.Plots
local plotLocationsFolder = workspace.Map.PlotLocations

local Configuration = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Configuration)
local SignalBank = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.SignalBank)
local PlotModule = require(ServerScriptService.Classes.Plot)
local PlayerDataModule = require(ServerScriptService.Services.PlayerSetUpService.Modules.PlayerDataModule)
local Networker = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Networker)

local TEMPLATE_PLOT_NAME = "PlotTemplate"
local random = Random.new()
local plotNetworker = Networker.server.new("PlotService", PlotModule, {
	PlotModule.GetOwnersPlotModel
})

function PlotService.init()
	PlotService.CreatePlots()
		
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		-- if for WHATEVER reason plot module ctor yields and somebody leaves it wont completely fry this loop
		if not player or player.Parent ~= Players then continue end
		if not PlayerDataModule.Get(player) then continue end

		PlotService.SafeAssign(player)
	end

	SignalBank.PLAYER_DATA_LOADED:Connect(function(player: Player)
		PlotService.SafeAssign(player)
	end)
end

function PlotService.CreatePlots()
	local templatePlot = plotFolder:FindFirstChild(TEMPLATE_PLOT_NAME)
	if not templatePlot then
		warn(`[!] PlotHandler CRITICAL | No template plot found. Ensure a plot named "{TEMPLATE_PLOT_NAME}" is found in {plotFolder:GetFullName()}`)
		return
	end
	
	templatePlot.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	
	for i = 1, Configuration.PlotCount do
		local plotName = `Plot{i}`
		
		local pivotAttachment: Attachment = workspace.Map.PlotLocations:FindFirstChild(plotName)
		if not pivotAttachment then
			warn(`[!] PlotHandler CRITICAL | No location attachment found for {plotName} in {plotLocationsFolder:GetFullName()}; {plotName} will not be placed.`)
			continue	
		end
		
		local plot = templatePlot:Clone()
		plot.Name = plotName
		plot:PivotTo(pivotAttachment.WorldCFrame)
		plot:SetAttribute("PlotIndex", i)
		plot.Parent = workspace.Map.Plots
		if i == Configuration.PlotCount then
			local bridge = plot:FindFirstChild("Bridge")
			if bridge then
				bridge:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end
end

	local availablePlots = {}

	for i = 1, Configuration.PlotCount do

		end

		availablePlots[#availablePlots + 1] = i
	end

	local randomPlot = availablePlots[random:NextInteger(1,#availablePlots)]

	PlotModule.new(player, plotModel)

	return true

local UIServiceServer = {}

function UIServiceServer.init()
	UIServiceServer.initializeScriptsInFolder(script.Parent.Modules)
end

function UIServiceServer.initializeScriptsInFolder(folder: Folder)
	for _, module in folder:GetChildren() do
		if not module:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			continue
		end

		if module then
			task.spawn(function()
				local success, result = pcall(require, module)
				if not success then 
					warn(`{module.Name} module require failed. {result}`)
					return 
				end

				local requiredModule = result

				success, result = pcall(requiredModule.init)
				if not success then
					warn(`{module.Name} module initialization failed. {result}`)
					return
				end
			end)
		end
	end
end

return UIServiceServer

	if not player then
		return
	end
	if typeof(plantName) ~= "string" then
		return
	end
	local seedInfo = PlantData[plantName]
	if not seedInfo then
		return
	end
	local playerData = PlayerDataModule.Get(player) :: PlayerDataModule.PlayerData

	playerData:Set({"SeedShopInfo", "StockInfo", plantName}, math.max(0, stock - 1))
end

local PlatformsServer = {}

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
local ProximityPromptService = game:GetService("ProximityPromptService")

local Networker = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Networker)
local validateNumber = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.TypeValidation.validateNumber)
local PlayerDataModule = require(ServerScriptService.Services.PlayerSetUpService.Modules.PlayerDataModule)
local PlotModule = require(ServerScriptService.Classes.Plot)
local PlatformPrices = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.PlatformCosts)
local Configuration = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Configuration)
local ServerUtils = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.ServerUtils)
local EnemyData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Enemies)
local SharedUtils = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.SharedUtils)
local ApplyModelModifications = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.ApplyModelModifications)

local purchasePlatformNetworker: Networker.Server
local equipBestNetworker: Networker.Server

function PlatformsServer.init()
	purchasePlatformNetworker = Networker.server.new("PurchasePlatform", PlatformsServer, {
		PlatformsServer.purchasePlatform,
	})
	equipBestNetworker = Networker.server.new("EquipBest", PlatformsServer, {
		PlatformsServer.equipBestNPCs
	})
	
	PlatformsServer._listenForNPCPlatformSwap()
end

function PlatformsServer:equipBestNPCs(player: Player)
	if not player then
		return
	end
	local playerData = PlayerDataModule.Get(player) :: PlayerDataModule.PlayerData
	if not playerData then
		return
	end
	local plot = PlotModule.GetFromOwner(player)
	if not plot or not playerData then
		return
	end
	local plotModel = plot.Model :: typeof(workspace.Map.Plots.PlotTemplate)
	
	--// remove npc's from platforms
	for platformNumber, platformInfo in playerData.Profile.Data.Platforms do
		if platformInfo.Unlocked and platformInfo.NPC then
			local platformModel = plotModel.Platforms.Platforms:FindFirstChild(`Platform{platformNumber}`)
			PlatformsServer.removeNPCFromPlatform(player, playerData, platformInfo, platformModel, platformNumber)
		end
	end
	
	task.wait(0.1)
	
	--// make a list of the best npc's
	local npcList = {}
	for guid, npcInfo in playerData.Profile.Data.Inventory do
		if npcInfo.itemType == "NPC" and npcInfo.name ~= nil and npcInfo.mutation ~= nil and npcInfo.multiplier ~= nil then
			table.insert(npcList, npcInfo)
		end
	end
	table.sort(npcList, function(a, b)
		return SharedUtils.calculateMoneyPerSecond(a.name, a.multiplier, a.mutation) > SharedUtils.calculateMoneyPerSecond(b.name, b.multiplier, b.mutation)
	end)
	
	--// equip best npc's
	for platformNumber, platformInfo in playerData.Profile.Data.Platforms do
		if not platformInfo.Unlocked then
			break
		end
		local npcInfo = npcList[platformNumber]
		if not npcInfo then
			break
		end
		local platformModel = plotModel.Platforms.Platforms:FindFirstChild(`Platform{platformNumber}`)
		
		-- find tool for npc to swap
		local swappingNPCTool
		local backpack = player.Backpack:GetChildren()
		table.insert(backpack, player.Character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool"))
		for _, tool in backpack do
			if not tool then
				continue
			end
			if not tool:IsA("Tool") or not tool:HasTag("npcTool") then
				continue
			end
			
			local name = tool:GetAttribute("npc")
			local multiplier = math.floor(tool:GetAttribute("multiplier") * 10) / 10
			local mutation = tool:GetAttribute("mutation")
			
			if name == npcInfo.name and multiplier == npcInfo.multiplier and mutation == npcInfo.mutation then
				swappingNPCTool = tool
				break
			end
		end
		if not swappingNPCTool then
			continue
		end
		
		PlatformsServer.addNPCToPlatform(player, playerData, swappingNPCTool, platformModel)
		
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
end

function PlatformsServer:purchasePlatform(player: Player, platformNumber: number)
	if not player then
		return
	end
	local playerData = PlayerDataModule.Get(player) :: PlayerDataModule.PlayerData
	if not playerData then
		return
	end
	if not validateNumber(platformNumber) then
		return
	end
	local price = PlatformPrices[platformNumber]
	if not price then
		return
	end
	if playerData.Profile.Data.Money < price then
		return
	end
	local plot = PlotModule.GetFromOwner(player) :: PlotModule.Plot
	if not plot then
		return
	end
	
	playerData:Set({"Money"}, playerData.Profile.Data.Money - price)
	playerData:Set({"Platforms", platformNumber, "Unlocked"}, true)
	plot:updatePlatforms()
	purchasePlatformNetworker:fire(player, "purchasedPlatform", platformNumber)
end

function PlatformsServer.addNPCToPlatform(player, playerData, swappingNPCTool, platformModel)
	if not swappingNPCTool then
		warn("No tool to put onto platforms")
		return
	end
	local name = swappingNPCTool:GetAttribute("npc")
	local desiredNPC = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Enemies:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not desiredNPC then
		print("couldn't find npc model")
		return
	end
	local platformNumber = tonumber(platformModel.Name:match("%d+"))
	
	-- remove the tool from players inv
	local multiplier = swappingNPCTool:GetAttribute("multiplier")
	local mutation = swappingNPCTool:GetAttribute("mutation")
	ServerUtils.removeTool(player, swappingNPCTool, "NPC")
	
	-- create npc
	local platformNPC = desiredNPC:Clone()
	platformNPC.Parent = platformModel
	platformNPC:PivotTo(platformModel.NPCCframe.WorldCFrame)
	for _, part in platformNPC:GetChildren() do
		if part:IsA("Part") or part:IsA("MeshPart") or part:IsA("UnionOperation") then
			part.Anchored = false
			part.CanCollide = false
			part.CanQuery = false
			part.CanTouch = false
			part.CollisionGroup = "enemy"
		end
	end
	ApplyModelModifications(platformNPC, multiplier, mutation)
	platformNPC.PrimaryPart.Anchored = true
	platformNPC:AddTag("platformNPC")

	-- save to player data
	playerData:Set({"Platforms", platformNumber}, {
		Unlocked = true,
		NPC = name,
		NPCMultiplier = (math.floor(multiplier * 10) / 10),
		NPCMutation = mutation,
		Money = 0,
		OfflineMoney = 0,
	})
end

function PlatformsServer.removeNPCFromPlatform(player, playerData, platformInfo, platformModel)
	local platformNumber = tonumber(platformModel.Name:match("%d+"))
	-- give npc tool
	if platformInfo.NPC then
		ServerUtils.addNPCTool(player, platformInfo.NPC, platformInfo.NPCMultiplier, platformInfo.NPCMutation)

		local moneyGained = platformInfo.Money or 0
		local offlineMoneyGained = platformInfo.OfflineMoney or 0
		local totalMoneyGained = math.max(0, platformInfo.Money + platformInfo.OfflineMoney)
		playerData:Set({"Money"}, playerData.Profile.Data.Money + totalMoneyGained)
		
		--// reset platform
		local NPC = platformModel:FindFirstChild(platformInfo.NPC)
		NPC:Destroy()
	end
	
	playerData:Set({"Platforms", platformNumber}, {
		Unlocked = true,
		NPC = nil,
		NPCMultiplier = nil,
		NPCMutation = nil,
		Money = 0,
		OfflineMoney = 0,
	})
end

function PlatformsServer._listenForNPCPlatformSwap()
	ProximityPromptService.PromptTriggered:Connect(function(prompt: ProximityPrompt, player: Player)
		if not player or not prompt:HasTag("platformNPCPrompt") then
			return
		end
		local playerData = PlayerDataModule.Get(player) :: PlayerDataModule.PlayerData
		local plot = PlotModule.GetFromOwner(player)
		if not plot or not playerData then
			return
		end
		local platformModel = prompt.Parent.Parent :: typeof(ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Extra.PlotAssets.platform)
		if platformModel.Parent.Parent.Parent ~= plot.Model then
			return
		end
		local platformNumber = tonumber(platformModel.Name:match("%d+"))
		local platformInfo = playerData.Profile.Data.Platforms[platformNumber]
		if not platformNumber or not platformInfo or (platformInfo and not platformInfo.Unlocked) then
			return
		end
		
		if platformInfo.NPC ~= nil then
			PlatformsServer.removeNPCFromPlatform(player, playerData, platformInfo, platformModel)
		end
		
		local swappingNPCTool = player.Character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")
		if not swappingNPCTool or (swappingNPCTool and not EnemyData[swappingNPCTool:GetAttribute("npc")]) then
			return
		end
		
		PlatformsServer.addNPCToPlatform(player, playerData, swappingNPCTool, platformModel)
	end)
end

return PlatformsServer

function PlantService:place(player: Player, plantName: string, position: Vector3, laneNumber: number, tool: Tool)
	if not player then
		print("No player")
		return
	end
	local playerData = PlayerDataModule.Get(player)
	if not playerData then
		warn("Couldn't find data for player")
		return
	end
	if SharedUtils.getPlantsPlaced(playerData.Profile.Data) >= playerData.Profile.Data.LanesUnlocked * Configuration.MaxPlantsPlacedPerLane then
		print("Max plants placed")
		return
	end
	if not tool then
		local plantSave = playerData.Profile.Data.Inventory[plantName]
		local amountOfSeed = plantSave.amount
		if not amountOfSeed or (amountOfSeed and amountOfSeed <= 0) then
			warn("Not enough of seed:", amountOfSeed)
			return
		end
	end
	if typeof(plantName) ~= "string" then
		warn("Plant name isn't a string")
		return
	end
	local placingPlantData = PlantData[plantName]
	if not placingPlantData then
		warn("No placing data for plant:",plantName)
		return
	end
	if not validateNumber(laneNumber) then
		print("no lane number")
		return
	end
	if not validateVector3(position) then
		print("not valid position")
		return
	end
	local xPos = position.X

	if not plotObject then
		warn("Couldn't find players plot model")
		return
	end
	local laneModel = plotObject.Model.Lanes.Lanes:FindFirstChild(`Lane{laneNumber}`)
	if not laneModel then
		warn("Couldn't find lane inside plot")
		return
	end
	local xCenterLane = laneModel:GetPivot().Position.X
	if xCenterLane + 3 < xPos or xCenterLane - 3 > xPos then
		warn("Not placed inside lane")
		return
	end
	if not playerData.Profile.Data.Lanes[laneNumber] then
		print("lane not unlocked")
		return
	end
	
	if tool then
		local plantNumber = tool:GetAttribute("plantNumber")
		local timePlaced = 0 -- so the plant grows instantly
		local multiplier = tool:GetAttribute("multiplier")
		local mutation = tool:GetAttribute("mutation")
		
		PlantModule.new(player, plotObject, plantName, position, laneNumber, {plantNumber, timePlaced, multiplier, mutation})
		ServerUtils.removeTool(player, tool, if tool:HasTag("seed") then "plant" else "NPC")
	else
		PlantModule.new(player, plotObject, plantName, position, laneNumber)
		ServerUtils.addSeedTool(player, plantName, -1)
	end

local function getAliveEnemies(plot: PlotModule.Plot)
	local aliveEnemies = 0
	for _, lane in plot.enemiesInLanes do
		for _, enemy in lane do
			if enemy.health > 0 then
				aliveEnemies += 1
			end
		end
	end
	return aliveEnemies
end

local function getPlantsPlaced(plot: PlotModule.Plot)
	local plants = 0
	for _, lane in plot.plantsInLanes do
		for _, plant in lane do
			if plant then

			end
		end

	return plants

function SpawnService.init()
	SignalBank.PLAYER_DATA_LOADED:Connect(function(player: Player)
		local playerData = PlayerDataModule.WaitFor(player)
		
		while playerData.Profile.Data.Tutorial < 10 do
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
		
		local playerPlot = nil
		while not playerPlot do
			playerPlot = PlotModule.GetFromOwner(player)
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
		
		while player.Parent do
			while getPlantsPlaced(playerPlot) == 0 or getAliveEnemies(playerPlot) > 0 do
				task.wait(1)
			end
			
			if not player.Parent then
				return
			end
			
			for _ = 1, math.random(1, math.max(1, playerData.Profile.Data.EnemiesSpawned / 100)) do
				for laneNumber = 1, 7 do
					if not playerData.Profile.Data.Lanes[laneNumber] then
						continue
					end
					SpawnService.SpawnEnemy(player, playerData)
					
					task.wait(Configuration.EnemySpawnIncrement)
				end
			end
			
			task.wait(6)
		end
	end)

	local legendaryList = {}
	for enemyName, enemyInfo in EnemyData do
		if not ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Enemies:FindFirstChild(enemyName) then
			warn("Couldn't find item model:",enemyName)
			continue
		end
		if enemyInfo.rarity ~= "Legendary" then
			continue
		end
		
		legendaryList[enemyName] = 1 / RarityData[enemyInfo.rarity].chance
	end
	
	return pickRandom(player, 1, legendaryList)

local function getMythicNPC(player)
	local mythicList = {}
	for enemyName, enemyInfo in EnemyData do
		if not ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Enemies:FindFirstChild(enemyName) then
			warn("Couldn't find item model:",enemyName)
			continue
		end
		if enemyInfo.rarity ~= "Mythic" then
			continue
		end

		mythicList[enemyName] = 1 / RarityData[enemyInfo.rarity].chance
	end
	
	return pickRandom(player, 1, mythicList)

function SpawnService.SpawnEnemy(player: Player, playerData: PlayerDataModule.PlayerData)
	local enemyLuck = 1
	if ReplicatedStorage.ServerLuck.TimeBought.Value + 15*60 > os.time() then
		enemyLuck *= ReplicatedStorage.ServerLuck.Luck.Value
	end
	
	local randomEnemyName = pickRandom(player, enemyLuck, enemyList)
	if not randomEnemyName then
		warn("!! No items have rarities !!")
		return
	end
	if playerData.Profile.Data.EnemiesSpawned > 0 then
		if playerData.Profile.Data.EnemiesSpawned % 500 == 0 then
			print("GUARANTEED MYTHIC")
			randomEnemyName = getMythicNPC(player) or randomEnemyName
		elseif playerData.Profile.Data.EnemiesSpawned % 100 == 0 then
			print("GUARANTEED LEGENDARY")
			randomEnemyName = getLegendaryNPC(player) or randomEnemyName
		end
	end
	if playerData.Profile.Data.Tutorial < 10 then
		randomEnemyName = pickRandom(player, 0, enemyList) -- force the first enemy to spawn
	end
		
	local availableLanes = {}
	for laneNumber, active in playerData.Profile.Data.Lanes do
		if active then
			table.insert(availableLanes, laneNumber)
		end
	end
	local randomLane = availableLanes[math.random(1,#availableLanes)]
	
	EnemyModule.new(player, randomEnemyName, randomLane, enemySpawnNetworker)
	playerData.Set({"EnemiesSpawned"}, playerData.Profile.Data.EnemiesSpawned + 1)
end

SpawnService.enemySpawnNetworker = enemySpawnNetworker

return SpawnService

-- modules

-- variables

local function pickRandom(player, luck, list, seed)
	if not player or not luck or not list then
		warn("Couldn't pick random")
		return
	end
	
	seed = seed and player.UserId * seed or tick() -- fallback seed if none
	local random = Random.new(seed)
	--luck = luck or
	
	local candidates = {}
	
	local sortedList = {}
	for name, rarity in list do table.insert(sortedList, name) end
	table.sort(sortedList, function(a, b)
		return list[b] > list[a]  
	end)
	
	local chosenName = sortedList[next(sortedList)]
	
	for _, name in sortedList do
		local rarity = list[name]
		local chance = rarity / luck

		-- regular check for luck
		local randomNum = random:NextInteger(1,rarity)
		if (randomNum / luck) <= 1 then
			table.insert(candidates, name)
		end
	end
	
	-- Pick randomly among all candidates that passed
	if #candidates > 0 then
		local chosenIndex = random:NextInteger(1, #candidates)
		return candidates[chosenIndex]
	end

	-- Fallback: return a worst enemy if none is passed
	return sortedList[next(sortedList)]
end

return pickRandom

	local handlerInfo = purchaseHandlers[receiptInfo.ProductId]
	
	if handlerInfo == nil then 
		warn(`Product {receiptInfo.ProductId} has no purchase handler info.`)
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	
	if handlerInfo.RequiresPlayer and ( player == nil or player.Parent ~= Players ) then

	if handlerInfo.Handler then

local ServerUtils = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.ServerUtils)
local ApplyModelModifications = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.ApplyModelModifications)
local ProductData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Products)

local playerPlots = {} :: {[Player] : Plot}
local newlyCreated = Signal.new()
local cashEffectNetworker = Networker.server.new("CashEffect", Plot, {})

export type Plot = typeof(setmetatable(
	{} :: {
		Model: typeof(workspace.Map.Plots.PlotTemplate),
		Owner: Player,
		OwnerData: PlayerDataModule.PlayerData,
		enemiesInLanes: {},
		_janitor: Janitor,
	}, 
	Plot
))

function Plot.new(owner: Player, model: Model, plotNetworker: Networker.Server): Plot
	local self: Plot = setmetatable({}, Plot)
	
	self.Model = model
	self.Model:SetAttribute("Occupied", true)
	self.Owner = owner
	self.OwnerData = PlayerDataModule.Get(owner)
	
	self.growingPlants = {}
	self.plantsInLanes = {}
	self.enemiesInLanes = {}
	for _ = 1, 7 do
		table.insert(self.enemiesInLanes, {})
		table.insert(self.plantsInLanes, {})
	end
	self._janitor = Janitor.new()
	
	self:init()
	
	playerPlots[owner] = self
	newlyCreated:Fire(owner, self)
	
	return self
end

function Plot.GetFromOwner(owner: Player)
	return playerPlots[owner]
end

function Plot.GetOwnersPlotModel(Plot: Plot, owner: Player)
	local plot = Plot.GetFromOwner(owner)
	local exitCount = 100
	while not plot or exitCount <= 0 do
		task.wait(0.1)
		plot = Plot.GetFromOwner(owner)
		exitCount -= 1
	end
	
	return plot.Model
end

--// Methods
function Plot.init(self: Plot)
	self:BringOwner()

	-- Update sign on the plot to show the owner's name and thumbnail
	local thumbnailUri = Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(self.Owner.UserId, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size420x420)
	self.Model.OwnerBillboard.BillboardGui.NameLabel.Text = self.Owner.DisplayName .. "'s Plot"
	self.Model.OwnerBillboard.BillboardGui.ImageLabel.ImageContent = Content.fromUri(thumbnailUri)
	self.Model.OwnerBillboard.BillboardGui.Enabled = true
	
	-- update plot buttons
	self:updateLanes()
	self:updatePlatforms()
	
	-- attack enemies when inside lane
	for laneNumber, enemiesInLane in self.enemiesInLanes do
		task.spawn(self._attackEnemiesInLane, self, laneNumber)
	end
	
	-- load plants
	self:_loadPlants()
		
	-- load offline cash
	self:_loadOfflineMoney()
	self:_loadPlatformNPCs()
	
	self:_beginRevenueGeneration()
	
	self._janitor:Add(self.Model, "Destroy")
	
	self._janitor:Add(self.Model.Monetization.GrowAllSignDevProduct.GrowAllPrompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
		if self.Owner ~= player then
			return
		end
		
		local productInfo = ProductData["grow all"]
		if not productInfo then
			warn("No product info for grow all")
			return
		end

		MarketplaceService:PromptProductPurchase(player, productInfo.id)
	end), "Disconnect")
end

function Plot.BringOwner(self: Plot, _threaded)
	if not _threaded then
		return task.spawn(self.BringOwner, self, true)
	end

	local character = self.Owner.Character or self.Owner.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	character:PivotTo(self.Model.OwnerSpawnPoint.WorldCFrame)
end

function Plot._loadOfflineMoney(self: Plot)
	if self.OwnerData.Profile.Data.ExitTimestamp == 0 then
		return
	end
	
	local timeSinceLastPlayed = os.time() - self.OwnerData.Profile.Data.ExitTimestamp
	
	for platformNumber, platformInfo in self.OwnerData.Profile.Data.Platforms do
		self.OwnerData:Set({"Platforms", platformNumber, "OfflineMoney"}, 0)
		if platformInfo.NPC ~= nil then
			local incomePerSecond = SharedUtils.calculateMoneyPerSecond(platformInfo.NPC, platformInfo.NPCMultiplier, platformInfo.NPCMutation, self.Owner)
			local incomeEarned = incomePerSecond * timeSinceLastPlayed
			self.OwnerData:SetValues({"Platforms", platformNumber}, {
				OfflineMoney = incomeEarned,
				Money = platformInfo.Money + incomeEarned,
			})
		end
	end
end

function Plot._beginRevenueGeneration(self: Plot)
	if self._generatingRevenue then return end
	self._generatingRevenue = true
	
	local timer = Timer.new(1)
	timer.Tick:Connect(function()
		for platformNumber, platformInfo in self.OwnerData.Profile.Data.Platforms do
			if not platformInfo.Unlocked or not platformInfo.NPC then
				continue
			end
			
			local income = SharedUtils.calculateMoneyPerSecond(platformInfo.NPC, platformInfo.NPCMultiplier, platformInfo.NPCMutation, self.Owner)
			self.OwnerData:Set({"Platforms", platformNumber, "Money"}, platformInfo.Money + income)
		end
	end)

	self._janitor:Add(timer, "Destroy")
	timer:Start()
end

function Plot._loadPlatformNPCs(self: Plot)
	for platformNumber, platformInfo in self.OwnerData.Profile.Data.Platforms do
		if not platformInfo.Unlocked then
			continue
		end
		if platformInfo.NPC then
			local name = platformInfo.NPC
			local multiplier = platformInfo.NPCMultiplier
			local mutation = platformInfo.NPCMutation
			local desiredNPC = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Enemies:FindFirstChild(name)
			if not desiredNPC then
				warn("Couldn't find npc model", name)
				continue
			end
			local platform = self.Model.Platforms.Platforms:FindFirstChild(`Platform{platformNumber}`)
			
			local platformNPC = desiredNPC:Clone()
			platformNPC.Parent = platform
			platformNPC:PivotTo(platform.NPCCframe.WorldCFrame)
			for _, part in platformNPC:GetChildren() do
				if part:IsA("Part") or part:IsA("MeshPart") or part:IsA("UnionOperation") then
					part.Anchored = false
					part.CanCollide = false
					part.CanQuery = false
					part.CanTouch = false
					part.CollisionGroup = "enemy"
				end
			end
			ApplyModelModifications(platformNPC, multiplier, mutation)
			platformNPC.PrimaryPart.Anchored = true
			SharedUtils.updateNPCOverhead(platformNPC, name, multiplier, multiplier, platformInfo.Money, platformInfo.OfflineMoney, self.Owner)
			platformNPC:AddTag("platformNPC")
		end
	end
end

function Plot._loadPlants(self: Plot)
	for plantNumber, plantInfo in self.OwnerData.Profile.Data.Plants do
		if not plantInfo then
			continue
		end
		
		local name = plantInfo[1]
		local position = Vector3.new(table.unpack(plantInfo[2]))
		local lane = plantInfo[3]
		local timePlaced = plantInfo[4]
		local multiplier = plantInfo[5]
		local mutation = plantInfo[6]
		
		PlantModule.new(self.Owner, self, name, position, lane, {plantNumber, timePlaced, multiplier, mutation}, true)
	end
end

function Plot.updatePlatforms(self: Plot)
	for number, platformInfo in self.OwnerData.Profile.Data.Platforms do
		local platformPlacementAtt = self.Model.Platforms.Placement:FindFirstChild(number)
		if not platformPlacementAtt then
			break
		end
		
		local unlocked = platformInfo.Unlocked
		
		local existingModel = self.Model.Platforms.Platforms:FindFirstChild(`Platform{number}`)
		if existingModel then
			if unlocked and not existingModel:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true) then
				existingModel:Destroy()
			else
				continue
			end
		end
		
		local plotAssets = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Extra.PlotAssets
		local modelClone = if platformInfo.Unlocked then plotAssets.platform:Clone() else plotAssets.platformButton:Clone()
		modelClone.Parent = self.Model.Platforms.Platforms
		modelClone:PivotTo(self.Model.Platforms.Placement[number].WorldCFrame)
		modelClone.Name = `Platform{number}`
		
		if unlocked then
			local container = modelClone:FindFirstChild("container")
			local collectZone = Zone.new(container)
			
			self._janitor:Add(collectZone.playerEntered:Connect(function(playerEntered)
				if self.Owner == playerEntered then
					if self.OwnerData.Profile.Data.Platforms[number].NPC ~= nil then
						self.OwnerData:Set({"Money"}, self.OwnerData.Profile.Data.Money + self.OwnerData.Profile.Data.Platforms[number].Money)
						self.OwnerData:SetValues({"Platforms", number}, {
							Money = 0,
							OfflineMoney = 0,
						})
						
						cashEffectNetworker:fire(self.Owner, "CashEffect", self.Owner.Character:GetPivot().Position)
					end
				end
			end), "Disconnect")
		else
			local ui = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Extra.CostUI:Clone()
			ui.Parent = modelClone
			ui.Adornee = modelClone
			ui.MoneyLabel.Text = `${SharedUtils.AddCommas(PlatformCosts[number])}`
			
			break
		end
		if (RebirthData[self.OwnerData.Profile.Data.Rebirths] and (RebirthData[self.OwnerData.Profile.Data.Rebirths].platforms and RebirthData[self.OwnerData.Profile.Data.Rebirths].platforms <= number)) then
			break
		end
	end
end

function Plot.updateLanes(self: Plot)
	-- update Lane colors
	local laneCosts = {10000000, 2500000, 100000, 0, 100000, 2500000, 10000000}
	local orangeToGreenColor = {
		[Color3.fromRGB(170, 85, 0)] = Color3.fromRGB(94, 141, 19),
		[Color3.fromRGB(148, 74, 0)] = Color3.fromRGB(90, 117, 17),
		[Color3.fromRGB(122, 61, 0)] = Color3.fromRGB(76, 98, 14),
	}
	local buttonTemplate = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Extra.PlotAssets.laneButton
	local lawnMowerTemplate = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Extra.PlotAssets.lawnMower
	
	local function swapPartColor(unlocked: boolean, part: Part)
		local currentColor = part.Color
		for orangeColor, greenColor in orangeToGreenColor do
			if unlocked and part.Color == orangeColor then
				part.Color = greenColor
			elseif not unlocked and part.Color == greenColor then
				part.Color = orangeColor
			end
		end
	end
	
	for laneNumber, unlocked in self.OwnerData.Profile.Data.Lanes do
		local lane = self.Model.Lanes.Lanes:FindFirstChild(`Lane{laneNumber}`)
		
		for _, part in lane:GetChildren() do
			if not part:IsA("Part") then
				continue
			end
			
			swapPartColor(unlocked, part)
		end
		
		--update lawn mower/button
		local existingModel = self.Model.Lanes.LanesButtons:FindFirstChild(`Lane{laneNumber}`)
		if (existingModel and existingModel:FindFirstChild("container")) then
			if unlocked then
				existingModel:Destroy()
			else
				continue
			end
		end
		
		local clone = if unlocked then lawnMowerTemplate:Clone() else buttonTemplate:Clone()
		clone.Parent = self.Model.Lanes.LanesButtons
		clone:PivotTo(self.Model.Lanes.LawnMowerLocations[laneNumber].WorldCFrame)
		clone.Name = `Lane{laneNumber}`
		if unlocked then
			local _janitor = Janitor.new()
			_janitor:Add(clone.LawnMower.ClearPrompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
				if player ~= self.Owner then
					return
				end
				local productInfo = ProductData[`Clear row {laneNumber}`]
				if not productInfo then
					warn("No product info for lawn mower")
					_janitor:Destroy()
					return
				end
				
				MarketplaceService:PromptProductPurchase(player, productInfo.id)
			end), "Disconnect")
			clone.AncestryChanged:Once(function()
				_janitor:Destroy()
			end)
		else
			local ui = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Extra.CostUI:Clone()
			ui.Parent = clone
			ui.Adornee = clone
			ui.MoneyLabel.Text = `${SharedUtils.AddCommas(laneCosts[laneNumber])}`
		end
	end
end

function Plot._attackEnemiesInLane(self: Plot, laneNumber)
	while self.Owner do
		local enemies = self.enemiesInLanes[laneNumber]
		if #enemies > 0 then
			-- loop through plants in the lane
			for _, plant in self.plantsInLanes[laneNumber] do
				if not plant.isAttacking then
					plant.isAttacking = true
					
					local target = enemies[1]
					if not target then
						continue
					end
					task.delay(0.2, target.damage, target, plant.DAMAGE)
					--target:damage(plant.DAMAGE)
					
					task.delay(Configuration.PlantAttackSpeed, function()
						plant.isAttacking = false
					end)
				end
			end
		end
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
end

function Plot.Destroy(self: Plot)
	print(`Destroying Plot object for {self.Owner.Name}. The physical model will be reset separately.`)
	
	self.Owner = nil
	self.OwnerData = nil
	
	self._janitor:Destroy()
	
	setmetatable(self, nil)
	local plotIndex = self.Model.Name:match("%d+")
	self.Model:Destroy()
	self.Model = nil
	ServerUtils.RecreatePlot(plotIndex)
end

return Plot

local Plant = {}
Plant.__index = Plant

local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local PlayerDataModule = require(ServerScriptService.Services.PlayerSetUpService.Modules.PlayerDataModule)
local PlantData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Plants)
local SharedUtils = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.SharedUtils)
local Janitor = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Zone.Janitor)
local ServerUtils = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.ServerUtils)
local getRandomSize = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.getRandomSize)
local MutationData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Mutations)
local pickRandom = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.StockController.RegularPickRandom)
local ApplyModelModifications = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.ApplyModelModifications)
local Configuration = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Configuration)

function Plant.new(owner: Player, plotObject, plantName: string, position: Vector3, laneNumber: number, existingData: {}, loading: boolean)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Plant)
	
	self.OWNER = owner
	self.OWNER_DATA = PlayerDataModule.Get(owner)
	self.NAME = plantName
	self.DATA = PlantData[self.NAME]
	if not self.DATA then 
		warn("err finding plant data") 
		return 
	end
	self.LOADING = loading
	self.LANE = laneNumber
	self.PLANT_NUMBER = existingData and existingData[1] or self.OWNER_DATA.Profile.Data.PlayerStats.TotalPlantsPlaced + 1
	self.TIME_PLACED = existingData and existingData[2] or os.time()
	self.PLOT_OBJECT = plotObject
	self.POSITION = if existingData and loading then self.PLOT_OBJECT.Model.Lanes.Lanes[`Lane{self.LANE}`]:GetPivot().Position + position else position
	self.MULTIPLIER = if (existingData and existingData[3]) then existingData[3] else getRandomSize(1, 1, 3, 1)
	self.MULTIPLIER = math.floor(self.MULTIPLIER * 10) / 10
	if (existingData and existingData[4]) then
		self.MUTATION =  existingData[4]
	else
		local mutationList = {}
		for name, info in MutationData do
			mutationList[name] = 1 / (info.chance)
		end
		self.MUTATION = pickRandom(self.OWNER, 1, mutationList)
	end
	self.DAMAGE = math.floor(self.DATA.damage * self.MULTIPLIER * MutationData[self.MUTATION].multiplier * 10) / 10
	
	
	--[[
		Existing data:
		1. plant number
		2. time placed
		3. multiplier
		4. mutation
	]]
	
	self.MODEL = nil
	self.GROWING_PART = nil
	self.isAttacking = false
	self._janitor = Janitor.new()
	
	--// create model
	if self.TIME_PLACED + self.DATA.timeToGrow <= os.time() then
		self:createModel()
	else
		self:createGrowingModel()
	end
	
	--// save plant
	if not loading then
		self.OWNER_DATA:Set({"PlayerStats", "TotalPlantsPlaced"}, self.OWNER_DATA.Profile.Data.PlayerStats.TotalPlantsPlaced + 1)
		position = (position - self.PLOT_OBJECT.Model.Lanes.Lanes[`Lane{self.LANE}`]:GetPivot().Position)
		self.OWNER_DATA:Set({"Plants", tonumber(self.PLANT_NUMBER)}, {
			self.NAME, 
			{SharedUtils.RoundNumber(position.X, 1), SharedUtils.RoundNumber(position.Y, 1), SharedUtils.RoundNumber(position.Z, 1)}, 
			laneNumber, 
			self.TIME_PLACED,
			self.MULTIPLIER,
			self.MUTATION
		})
	end
	
	return self
end

function Plant.createGrowingModel(self: Plant)
	local timeTillComplete = self.DATA.timeToGrow - (os.time() - self.TIME_PLACED)
	
	self.GROWING_PART = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Extra.growing:Clone()
	self.GROWING_PART.Parent = self.PLOT_OBJECT.Model.Plants
	self.GROWING_PART.CFrame = CFrame.new(self.POSITION) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi, 0)
	
	self.GROWING_PART.Stats.Title.Text = self.NAME
	local days, hours, minutes, seconds = SharedUtils.CalculateHoursMinutesSeconds(timeTillComplete)
	days = if days > 0 then `{days}d ` else ""
	hours = if (hours > 0 or days ~= "") then `{hours}h ` else ""
	minutes = if (minutes > 0 or hours ~= "" or days ~= "") then `{minutes}m ` else ""
	seconds = `{seconds}s`
	self.GROWING_PART.Stats.TimeLeft.Text = `({days .. hours .. minutes .. seconds})`
	self.GROWING_PART.Stats.PercentGrown.Text = `{SharedUtils.RoundNumber((1 - timeTillComplete / self.DATA.timeToGrow) * 100, 1)}%`
	
	self.GROWING_PART:SetAttribute("timePlaced", self.TIME_PLACED)
	self.GROWING_PART:SetAttribute("name", self.NAME)
	
	task.delay(timeTillComplete, function()
		if self.GROWING_PART then
			table.remove(self.PLOT_OBJECT.growingPlants, table.find(self.PLOT_OBJECT.growingPlants, self))
			self.GROWING_PART:Destroy()
			self.GROWING_PART = nil
			self:createModel()
		end
	end)
	
	table.insert(self.PLOT_OBJECT.growingPlants, self)
	
	self._janitor:Add(self.GROWING_PART, "Destroy")
end

function Plant.createModel(self: Plant)
	local desiredModel
	if Configuration.MutationMode == "Runtime" then
		desiredModel = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Plants:FindFirstChild(self.NAME)
	elseif Configuration.MutationMode == "Manual" then
		local desiredFolder = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Plants:FindFirstChild(self.MUTATION or "Normal")
		desiredModel = desiredFolder:FindFirstChild(self.NAME)
	end
	if not desiredModel then
		warn("Couldn't find plant model")
		return
	end
	if not self.PLOT_OBJECT.Model then
		return
	end
	self.MODEL = desiredModel:Clone()
	self.MODEL.Parent = self.PLOT_OBJECT.Model.Plants
	for _, part in self.MODEL:GetChildren() do
		if not part:IsA("Part") and not part:IsA("UnionOperation") then
			continue
		end
		
		part.Anchored = false
		part.CanCollide = false
		part.CanQuery = true
		part.CanTouch = true
	end
	self.MODEL.PrimaryPart.Anchored = true
	self.MODEL:PivotTo(CFrame.new(self.POSITION) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi, 0))
	ApplyModelModifications(self.MODEL, self.MULTIPLIER, self.MUTATION)
	
	self.MODEL:SetAttribute("playerName", self.OWNER.Name)
	self.MODEL:SetAttribute("name", self.NAME)
	self.MODEL:SetAttribute("laneNumber", self.LANE)
	self.MODEL:SetAttribute("mutation", self.MUTATION)
	self.MODEL:SetAttribute("multiplier", self.MULTIPLIER)
	self.MODEL:SetAttribute("damage", self.DAMAGE)
	self.MODEL:AddTag("plant")
	if not self.LOADING then
		self.OWNER_DATA:Set({"Index", self.MUTATION, self.NAME}, (self.OWNER_DATA.Profile.Data.Index[self.MUTATION][self.NAME] or 0) + 1)
	end
	
	table.insert(self.PLOT_OBJECT.plantsInLanes[self.LANE], self)
	
	self._janitor:Add(self.MODEL, "Destroy")
end

function Plant.destroy(self: Plant)
	if self.PLOT_OBJECT then
		local index = table.find(self.PLOT_OBJECT.plantsInLanes[self.LANE], self)
		table.remove(self.PLOT_OBJECT.plantsInLanes[self.LANE], index)
	end
	
	self.OWNER_DATA:Set({"Plants", self.PLANT_NUMBER}, nil)
	
	self._janitor:Destroy()
	
	for k in pairs(self) do
		self[k] = nil
	end
end

export type Plant = typeof(setmetatable({} :: {
	OWNER: Player;
	OWNER_DATA: PlayerDataModule.PlayerData;
	NAME: string;
	DATA: PlantData;
	POSITION: Vector3;
	LANE: number;
	TIME_PLACED: number;
	MODEL: Model;
	GROWING_PART: Part;
	DAMAGE: number;
	
	isAttacking: boolean,
	_janitor: Janitor,
}, Plant))

return Plant
