local Enemy = {}
Enemy.__index = Enemy

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local PlotModule = require(ServerScriptService.Classes.Plot)
local Networker = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Networker)
local enemyData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Enemies)
local Janitor = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Zone.Janitor)
local RarityData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Rarity)
local ServerUtils = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.ServerUtils)
local getRandomSize = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.getRandomSize)
local MutationData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Mutations)
local pickRandom = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.StockController.RegularPickRandom)
local PlayerDataModule = require(ServerScriptService.Services.PlayerSetUpService.Modules.PlayerDataModule)
local SharedUtils = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.SharedUtils)
local ApplyModelModifications = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.ApplyModelModifications)
local Configuration = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Configuration)

local function formatNumber(num)
	local suffixes = {"", "K", "M", "B", "T", "Qa", "Qi", "Sx", "Sp", "Oc", "No", "Dc"}
	local suffixIndex = 1

	while num >= 1000 and suffixIndex < #suffixes do
		num = num / 1000
		suffixIndex = suffixIndex + 1
	end

	if num >= 100 then
		return string.format("%d%s", math.floor(num), suffixes[suffixIndex])
	elseif num >= 10 then
		return string.format("%.1f%s", math.floor(num * 10) / 10, suffixes[suffixIndex])
	else
		return string.format("%.2f%s", math.floor(num * 100) / 100, suffixes[suffixIndex])
	end
end

function Enemy.new(player: Player, name: string, lane: number, networker: Networker.server)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Enemy)
	
	self.PLAYER = player
	self.PLAYER_DATA = PlayerDataModule.Get(player)
	self.NAME = name
	self.DATA = enemyData[name]
	self.LANE = lane
	self.NETWORKER = networker
	self.PLOT_OBJECT = PlotModule.GetFromOwner(player)
	self.MULTIPLIER = getRandomSize(1, 1, 3, 1)
	self.MULTIPLIER = math.floor(self.MULTIPLIER * 10) / 10
	local mutationList = {}
	for name, info in MutationData do
		mutationList[name] = 1 / (info.chance)
	end
	self.MUTATION = pickRandom(self.OWNER, 1, mutationList)
	self._janitor = Janitor.new()
	
	if self.PLAYER_DATA.Profile.Data.Tutorial < 10 then
		self.MUTATION = "Normal"
		self.MULTIPLIER = 1
	end
	
	self.maxHealth = math.floor(self.DATA.baseHealth * (self.MULTIPLIER or 1) * (MutationData[self.MUTATION].multiplier or 1))
	self.health = self.maxHealth
	
	self:createModel()
	--networker:fireAll("new", player, self.PLOT_OBJECT.Model, name, lane, {self.MUTATION})
	
	task.delay(10, function()
		table.insert(self.PLOT_OBJECT.enemiesInLanes[lane], self)
		task.wait(20)
		if self.health then
			self:destroy()
		end
	end)
	
	return self
end

-- create model
function Enemy.createModel(self: Enemy)
	local desiredModel
	if Configuration.MutationMode == "Runtime" then
		desiredModel = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Enemies:FindFirstChild(self.NAME)
	elseif Configuration.MutationMode == "Manual" then
		local desiredFolder = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Enemies:FindFirstChild(self.MUTATION or "Normal")
		desiredModel = desiredFolder:FindFirstChild(self.NAME)
	end
	if not desiredModel then
		warn("Couldn't find enemy model")
		return
	end
	if not self.PLOT_OBJECT.Model then
		return
	end
	self.MODEL = desiredModel:Clone()
	self.MODEL.Parent = self.PLOT_OBJECT.Model.Enemies
	if self.MODEL:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
		self.MODEL.Humanoid.EvaluateStateMachine = false
	end

	-- Set PrimaryPart if it doesn't exist
	if not self.MODEL.PrimaryPart then
		self.MODEL.PrimaryPart = self.MODEL:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	end

	for _, part in self.MODEL:GetChildren() do
		if part:IsA("Part") or part:IsA("MeshPart") or part:IsA("UnionOperation") then
			part.Anchored = false
			part.CanCollide = false
			part.CanQuery = false
			part.CanTouch = false
			part.CollisionGroup = "enemy"
		end
	end

	-- Only anchor if PrimaryPart exists
	if self.MODEL.PrimaryPart then
		self.MODEL.PrimaryPart.Anchored = true
	else
		warn("Model " .. self.NAME .. " has no PrimaryPart to anchor!")
	end

	ApplyModelModifications(self.MODEL, self.MULTIPLIER, self.MUTATION)

	-- add overhead ui
	local overheadUI = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Extra.EnemyOverhead:Clone()
	overheadUI.Parent = self.MODEL
	overheadUI.Adornee = self.MODEL
	local _, size = self.MODEL:GetBoundingBox()
	overheadUI.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, size.Y + 1, 0)
	overheadUI.Title.Text = self.NAME
	overheadUI.Rarity.Text = self.DATA.rarity
	overheadUI.Rarity.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	overheadUI.Rarity.RarityColor.Color = RarityData[self.DATA.rarity].color
	overheadUI.Mutation.Visible = (self.MUTATION ~= nil and self.MUTATION ~= "Normal")
	overheadUI.Mutation.Text = if self.MUTATION then self.MUTATION else ""
	overheadUI.Health.Amount.Text = `{formatNumber(self.health)}/{formatNumber(self.maxHealth)} HP`
	overheadUI.Health.Filler.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	overheadUI.Enabled = true

	if not self.PLOT_OBJECT.Model then
		self:destroy()
		return
	end

	self.MODEL:SetAttribute("maxHealth", self.maxHealth)
	self.MODEL:SetAttribute("playerName", self.PLAYER.Name)
	self.MODEL:SetAttribute("name", self.NAME)
	self.MODEL:SetAttribute("laneNumber", self.LANE)
	self.MODEL:SetAttribute("plotNumber", tonumber(self.PLOT_OBJECT.Model.Name:match("%d+")))
	self.MODEL:SetAttribute("mutation", self.MUTATION)
	self.MODEL:AddTag("enemy")

	self._janitor:Add(self.MODEL, "Destroy")
end

local function getInventoryLength(list)
	local length = 0
	for thing in list do
		length += 1
	end
	return length
end

function Enemy.damage(self: Enemy, damageTaken: number)
	if not self.health then
		return
	end
	
	self.health -= damageTaken
	
	if self.health <= 0 then
		if self.PLAYER_DATA.Profile.Data.AutoSell[self.MUTATION] or self.PLAYER_DATA.Profile.Data.AutoSell[self.DATA.rarity] then
			local sellAmount = SharedUtils.calculateSellPrice(self.NAME, self.MULTIPLIER, self.MUTATION, self.PLAYER)
			self.PLAYER_DATA:Set({"Money"}, self.PLAYER_DATA.Profile.Data.Money + sellAmount)
		else
			local maxInvLength = Configuration.MaxNPCsInInventory
			maxInvLength += if self.PLAYER_DATA.Profile.Data.OwnedProducts["extra inv space"] ~= nil then 150 else 0
			if getInventoryLength(self.PLAYER_DATA.Profile.Data.Inventory) <= 200 then
				ServerUtils.addNPCTool(self.PLAYER, self.NAME, self.MULTIPLIER, self.MUTATION)
			else
				-- don't give npc
			end
		end
		self.PLAYER_DATA:Set({"Index", self.MUTATION, self.NAME}, (self.PLAYER_DATA.Profile.Data.Index[self.MUTATION][self.NAME] or 0) + 1)
		
		self:destroy()
	end
end

function Enemy.destroy(self: Enemy)
	if self.PLOT_OBJECT then
		table.remove(self.PLOT_OBJECT.enemiesInLanes[self.LANE], table.find(self.PLOT_OBJECT.enemiesInLanes[self.LANE], self))
	end
	self._janitor:Destroy()
	
	-- Clear all keys in the table
	for k in pairs(self) do
		self[k] = nil
	end
end

export type Enemy = typeof(setmetatable({} :: {
    PLAYER: Player,
    NAME: string,
    DATA: any,
    LANE: number,
    NETWORKER: Networker.server,
    PLOT_OBJECT: PlotModule.Plot,
	MUTATION: string?,
	MODEL: Model,

	health: number,
	_janitor: Janitor,
}, Enemy))

return Enemy

local function validateSimpleTable(tbl: { [any]: any }, keyType: string, validator: (any) -> boolean): boolean
	-- Make sure this is actually a table
	if typeof(tbl) ~= "table" then
		return false
	end

	-- Validate all keys and values
	for key, value in tbl do
		if typeof(key) ~= keyType then
			return false
		end

		if not validator(value) then
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

--[[
	Ensures the instance is not an 'imposter' and is of the expected class.

	In cases where the server is expecting an instance, exploiters can pass a table with keys
	that mimic the instance's properties but set to whatever they want.

	e.g.
	local fakePart = {
		Position = Vector3.new()
	}

	remoteExpectingPart:FireServer(fakePart)

	It is unsafe for the server to blindly accept the position of this fake part without
	checking it is a valid instance first.
]]

local function validateInstance(instance: Instance, expectedClass: string): boolean
	if typeof(instance) ~= "Instance" then
		return false
	end

	return instance:IsA(expectedClass)
end

return validateInstance

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local DataManager = require(ServerScriptService.Data.DataManager)

local POSITION_BUFFER = 100 -- studs
local VELOCITY_SCALE = 0.03 -- tune

local function checkCheaters(character, distanceApart)
	if distanceApart > 2000 then
		local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
		if not player or not player.Parent then return end
		player.NotSavedValues.CollectHackNum.Value += 1
		if player.NotSavedValues.CollectHackNum.Value > 10 then
			DataManager.IncrementCheatingNumber(player)
			warn("PLAYER KICKED FOR CHEATING " .. player.PlayerValues.CheatingCheck.Value .. " - " .. player.UserId)
			player:Kick("Cheating")
		end
		return true
	end
end

return function(character, partTouched)
	local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then return false end
	if character.Humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
	-- allow small 3D distance OR generous vertical margin scaled by speed
	local v = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude
	local maxDist = POSITION_BUFFER + v * VELOCITY_SCALE 
	local distanceApart = math.abs(hrp.Position.Y - partTouched.Position.Y)
	checkCheaters(character, distanceApart)
	if distanceApart > maxDist then
		-- but if we’re actually close in 3D, allow it
		if (hrp.Position - partTouched.Position).Magnitude > POSITION_BUFFER then
			return false
		end
		--warn("FAR AWAY", distanceApart, maxDist)
	end
	return true
end

local ServerUtils = {}

local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local SharedUtils = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.SharedUtils)
local PlayerDataModule = require(ServerScriptService.Services.PlayerSetUpService.Modules.PlayerDataModule)
local PlantData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Plants)
local ApplyModelModifications = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.ApplyModelModifications)

function ServerUtils.addSeedTool(player: Player, plantName: string, amount: number)
	amount = amount or 1
	local playerData = PlayerDataModule.Get(player)
	
	local amountOfSeed = playerData.Profile.Data.Inventory[plantName] or 0
	if typeof(amountOfSeed) == "table" then
		amountOfSeed = amountOfSeed.amount
	end
	playerData:Set({"Inventory", plantName}, {
		itemType = "seed",
		["amount"] = amountOfSeed + amount
	})
	
	ServerUtils.giveSeedTool(player, plantName, amount)
end

function ServerUtils.giveSeedTool(player: Player, plantName: string, amount: number)
	if not player then
		return
	end
	amount = amount or 1
	
	local tool
	local char = player.Character or player.Character:Wait()
	if not char then
		warn("Couldn't find player's character to give seed")
		return
	end
	tool = char:FindFirstChild(`{plantName} Seed`) or player.Backpack:FindFirstChild(`{plantName} Seed`)
	
	if tool then
		local currentAmount = tool:GetAttribute("amount")
		tool:SetAttribute("amount", currentAmount + amount)
		if tool:GetAttribute("amount") <= 0 then
			tool:Destroy()
		end
	elseif amount > 0 then
		local desiredTool = ServerStorage.Tools.Seed
		local toolClone = desiredTool:Clone()
		toolClone.Parent = player.Backpack
		toolClone.Name = `{plantName} Seed`
		toolClone.Handle.Color = PlantData[plantName].seedColor
		toolClone.Handle.MaterialVariant = "Studs"
		toolClone:SetAttribute("amount", amount)
		toolClone:SetAttribute("plant", plantName)
	end
end

-- save plant tool
function ServerUtils.addPlantTool(player: Player, plantName: string, plantNumber: number, mutation: string, multiplier: number)
	if not player then
		return
	end
	local playerData = PlayerDataModule.Get(player)
	if not playerData then
		return
	end
	
	playerData:Set({"Inventory", tostring(plantNumber)}, {
		itemType = "plant",
		name = plantName,
		multiplier = multiplier,
		mutation = mutation,
	})
	
	ServerUtils.givePlantTool(player, plantName, plantNumber, mutation, multiplier)
end

-- give actual plant tool
function ServerUtils.givePlantTool(player: Player, plantName: string, plantNumber: number, mutation: string, multiplier: number)
	if not player then
		return
	end
	
	local desiredModel = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Plants:FindFirstChild(plantName)
	if not desiredModel then
		warn("Couldn't find plant model")
		return
	end
	
	--// create tool
	local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
	tool.Parent = player.Backpack
	local multiplierText = if multiplier and multiplier ~= 1 then "[" .. SharedUtils.RoundNumber(multiplier, 1) .. "x] " else ""
	local mutationText = if (mutation and mutation ~= "Normal") then "[" .. mutation .. "] " else ""
	tool.Name = `{multiplierText}{mutationText}{plantName}`
	tool.CanBeDropped = false
	tool.Grip = CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi, 0)
	tool:SetAttribute("plantNumber", plantNumber)
	tool:SetAttribute("multiplier", multiplier)
	tool:SetAttribute("mutation", mutation)
	tool:SetAttribute("plant", plantName)
	tool:AddTag("seed")
	
	--// clone plant model
	local modelClone = desiredModel:Clone()
	ApplyModelModifications(modelClone, multiplier, mutation)
	for _, part in modelClone:GetChildren() do
		if part:IsA("Part") or part:IsA("MeshPart") or part:IsA("UnionOperation") then
			if modelClone.PrimaryPart == part then
				part.Name = "Handle"
			end
			
			part.Massless = true
			part.Parent = tool
			part.Anchored = false
			part.CanCollide = false
		end
	end
	modelClone:Destroy()
end

function ServerUtils.removeTool(player: Player, tool: Tool, plantType: string)
	if not player then
		warn("Player was nil")
		return
	end
	local playerData = PlayerDataModule.Get(player) :: PlayerDataModule.PlayerData
	if not playerData then
		warn("Couldn't find player data")
		return
	end
	
	if plantType == "plant" then
		local plantName = tool:GetAttribute("plant")
		local plantNumber = tool:GetAttribute("plantNumber")
		
		playerData:Set({"Inventory", tostring(plantNumber)}, nil)
	elseif plantType == "NPC" then
		local name = tool:GetAttribute("npc")
		local guid = tool:GetAttribute("guid")

		playerData:Set({"Inventory", tostring(guid)}, nil)
	end
	
	tool:Destroy()
end

function ServerUtils.addNPCTool(player, npcName, multiplier, mutation)
	if not player then
		warn("Player was nil")
		return
	end
	local playerData = PlayerDataModule.Get(player) :: PlayerDataModule.PlayerData
	if not playerData then
		warn("Couldn't find player data")
		return
	end
	
	local guid = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
	playerData:Set({"Inventory", guid}, {
		itemType = "NPC",
		name = npcName,
		multiplier = (math.floor(multiplier * 10) / 10),
		mutation = mutation,
	})
	
	ServerUtils.giveNPCTool(player, npcName, guid, multiplier, mutation)
end

function ServerUtils.giveNPCTool(player, name, guid, multiplier, mutation)
	if not player or not name or not guid or not multiplier or not mutation then
		return
	end
	local desiredModel = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Enemies:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not desiredModel then
		warn("Couldn't find plant model")
		return
	end

	--// create tool
	local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
	tool.Parent = player.Backpack
	local multiplierText = if multiplier and multiplier ~= 1 then "[" .. SharedUtils.RoundNumber(multiplier, 1) .. "x] " else ""
	local mutationText = if (mutation and mutation ~= "Normal") then "[" .. mutation .. "] " else ""
	tool.Name = `{multiplierText}{mutationText}{name}`
	tool.CanBeDropped = false
	tool:SetAttribute("guid", guid)
	tool:SetAttribute("multiplier", multiplier)
	tool:SetAttribute("mutation", mutation)
	tool:SetAttribute("npc", name)
	tool:AddTag("npcTool")

	--// clone plant model
	local modelClone = desiredModel:Clone()
	ApplyModelModifications(modelClone, multiplier, mutation)
	SharedUtils.updateNPCOverhead(modelClone, name, multiplier, mutation, nil, nil, player)
	if modelClone:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
		modelClone.Humanoid.EvaluateStateMachine = false
	end
	for _, part in modelClone:GetChildren() do
		if part:IsA("Part") or part:IsA("MeshPart") or part:IsA("UnionOperation") then
			part.Massless = true
			part.Anchored = false
			part.CanCollide = false
			part.CollisionGroup = "enemy"
		end
		
		if modelClone.PrimaryPart == part then
			part.Name = "Handle"
			part.Parent = tool
		end
	end
	modelClone.Parent = tool
end

function ServerUtils.RecreatePlot(plotIndex: number)
	local model = ReplicatedStorage.PlotTemplate:Clone()
	model.Name = `Plot{plotIndex}`
	
	local original = workspace.Map.Plots:FindFirstChild(`Plot{plotIndex}`)
	if original then original:Destroy() end

	model:PivotTo(workspace.Map.PlotLocations:FindFirstChild(`Plot{plotIndex}`).WorldCFrame)
	model:SetAttribute("PlotIndex", plotIndex)
	model.Parent = workspace.Map.Plots

	return model
end

return ServerUtils

local StockController = {}
StockController.__index = StockController


local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local pickRandom = require(script.RegularPickRandom)
local SignalBank = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.SignalBank)

local playerStocks = {}


local playerDataModule = require(ServerScriptService.Services.PlayerSetUpService.Modules.PlayerDataModule)
local PlantData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Plants)

function StockController.init()
	playerStocks = {}
	SignalBank.PLAYER_DATA_LOADED:Connect(function(player: Player)
		StockController.new(player, "Seed", PlantData)
		--StockController.new(player, "Gear")
	end)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
		for stockType, stockPlayerList in playerStocks do
			for _, playerStock in stockPlayerList do
				if playerStock == player then
					playerStocks[stockType] = nil
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

function StockController.new(player, stockType: string, stockData: {})
	local self = setmetatable({}, StockController)
	
	self.player = player
	self.playerData = playerDataModule.Get(player) :: playerDataModule.PlayerData
	self.restockNum = 0
	self.stockRarityList = {}
	self.stock = {}
	self.stockType = stockType
	self.stockData = stockData
	
	for name, stockInfo in stockData do
		if not stockInfo.price then continue end
		self.stockRarityList[name] = 1 / (stockInfo.stockChance / 100)
	end
	
	-- creates values
	local setValuesList = {}
	for name, stockInfo in stockData do
		if not stockInfo.price then continue end
		
		self.stock[name] = self.playerData.Profile.Data[`{stockType}ShopInfo`].StockInfo[name] or 0
		setValuesList[name] = self.stock[name]
	end
	self.playerData:SetValues({`{stockType}ShopInfo`, "StockInfo"}, setValuesList)
	
	task.spawn(function()
		repeat task.wait(1) until 300 <= os.time() - self.playerData.Profile.Data[`{stockType}ShopInfo`].LastRestock
		self:restock()
	end)
	
	playerStocks[stockType] = playerStocks[stockType] or {}
	table.insert(playerStocks[stockType], self)
	
	return self
end

function StockController:restock()
	self.restockNum += 1
	-- sets last reset time
	self.playerData:Set({`{self.stockType}ShopInfo`, "LastRestock"}, os.time())

	-- reset stock to 0
	for name, stockAmount in pairs(self.stock) do
		self.stock[name] = 0
	end

	-- give each stock new random values
	local setValuesList = {}
	for name, _ in self.stock do
		local curSettings = self.stockData[name]
		for i = 1, curSettings.maxStockAmount do
			local chosenSeedToStock = pickRandom(self.player, 1, {
				[name] = self.stockRarityList[name],
				["none"] = 0.1,
			})
			if chosenSeedToStock ~= name then continue end
			self.stock[chosenSeedToStock] += 1
		end
		setValuesList[name] = self.stock[name]
	end

	-- update player values
	self.playerData:SetValues({`{self.stockType}ShopInfo`, "StockInfo"}, setValuesList)
	
	--TODO fire restock to client
	--restockRemote:FireClient(self.player)
	
	-- restock again
	local holderRestockNum = self.restockNum
	task.delay(5 * 60, function()
		if holderRestockNum ~= self.restockNum then return end
		if self.player.Parent == nil then return end
		
		self:restock()
	end)
end

function StockController.getStockFromPlayer(player: Player, stockType: string)
	if not stockType then
		warn("Didn't give stock type when retrieving player stock")
		return
	end
	for _, stockObject in playerStocks[stockType] do
		if stockObject.player == player then
			return stockObject
		end
	end
end

return StockController

local function skewedRandom(mean, stdDev, skew)
	local u1 = math.random()
	local u2 = math.random()
	local z = math.sqrt(-2 * math.log(u1)) * math.cos(2 * math.pi * u2)
	local value = mean + z * stdDev
	return math.pow(value, skew)
end

local function getRandomSize(skew, min, max, mean)
	local luckFactor = 1
	min = min or 0.8
	max = max or 2
	mean = mean or (min + max) / 2
	local stdDev = 0.3 * luckFactor

	local size = skewedRandom(mean, stdDev, skew)

	-- Clamp to hard min/max bounds
	size = math.clamp(size, min, max)

	return size
end

return getRandomSize

return function(context, players: {Player}, action: string, amount: number)
	action = action:lower()

	if amount ~= amount then
		return "Invalid amount (NaN)"
	end
	

	local validActions = {"give", "set"}
	local isValidAction = false
	for _, validAction in ipairs(validActions) do
		if action == validAction then
			isValidAction = true
			break
		end
	end

	if not isValidAction then
		return "Invalid action. Valid actions: give, set"
	end

	local results = {}

	for _, player in ipairs(players) do
		local playerData = PlayerDataModule.Get(player)
		local success, error = pcall(function()
			if action == "give" then
				playerData:Set({"Money"}, playerData.Profile.Data.Money + amount)
			elseif action == "set" then
				playerData:Set({"Money"}, amount)
			end
		end)

		if success then
			table.insert(results, string.format("%s: Success", player.Name))
		else
			table.insert(results, string.format("%s: Failed (%s)", player.Name, error or "Unknown error"))
		end
	end

	return table.concat(results, "\n")
end

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

_G.FlyConnections = _G.FlyConnections or {}
_G.FlyObjects = _G.FlyObjects or {}

local FLIGHT_SPEED = 50

return function(context, players: {Player}, enable: boolean?)
	if enable == nil then enable = true end
	local results = {}

	for _, player in ipairs(players) do
		local success, errorMsg = pcall(function()
			local character = player.Character
			if not character then
				error("No character")
				return
			end

			local humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
			local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not humanoid or not rootPart then
				error("Character missing components")
				return
			end

			if enable then
				-- Clean up existing fly objects first
				if _G.FlyConnections[player] then
					_G.FlyConnections[player]:Disconnect()
					_G.FlyConnections[player] = nil
				end

				if _G.FlyObjects[player] then
					for _, obj in pairs(_G.FlyObjects[player]) do
						if obj and obj.Parent then
							obj:Destroy()
						end
					end
					_G.FlyObjects[player] = nil
				end

				-- Create flight objects
				local bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
				bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(4000, 4000, 4000)
				bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
				bodyVelocity.Name = "FlyVelocity"
				bodyVelocity.Parent = rootPart

				-- Store objects for cleanup
				_G.FlyObjects[player] = {bodyVelocity}

				-- Set humanoid state
				humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, false)
				humanoid.PlatformStand = true

				-- Flight control loop - simple camera-based flying
				_G.FlyConnections[player] = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
					if not rootPart.Parent or not character.Parent then
						-- Character was destroyed, clean up
						if _G.FlyConnections[player] then
							_G.FlyConnections[player]:Disconnect()
							_G.FlyConnections[player] = nil
						end
						if _G.FlyObjects[player] then
							_G.FlyObjects[player] = nil
						end
						return
					end

					-- Get the player's camera through their PlayerGui
					local playerGui = player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
					if not playerGui then return end

					local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
					if not camera then return end

					local moveVector = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
					local humanoidMoveVector = humanoid.MoveDirection

					-- If player is moving, use camera direction
					if humanoidMoveVector.Magnitude > 0 then
						-- Get camera's look direction (forward/back)
						local lookDirection = camera.CFrame.LookVector
						local rightDirection = camera.CFrame.RightVector

						-- Calculate movement based on WASD input and camera direction
						local forwardMovement = lookDirection * -humanoidMoveVector.Z
						local rightMovement = rightDirection * humanoidMoveVector.X

						moveVector = forwardMovement + rightMovement
						moveVector = Vector3.new(moveVector.X, 0, moveVector.Z) -- Keep Y at 0 for now
					end

					-- Handle up/down movement with jump
					if humanoid.Jump then
						moveVector = moveVector + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
						humanoid.Jump = false
					end

					-- Apply movement
					bodyVelocity.Velocity = moveVector * FLIGHT_SPEED
				end)

				-- Send notification
				local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
				if remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Notification") then
					remotes.Notification:FireClient(player, "Success", "Flying enabled! Use WASD + mouse to fly, Space for up")
				end

			else
				-- Disable flying
				if _G.FlyConnections[player] then
					_G.FlyConnections[player]:Disconnect()
					_G.FlyConnections[player] = nil
				end

				-- Remove flight objects
				if _G.FlyObjects[player] then
					for _, obj in pairs(_G.FlyObjects[player]) do
						if obj and obj.Parent then
							obj:Destroy()
						end
					end
					_G.FlyObjects[player] = nil
				end

				-- Clean up any remaining objects by name
				local flyVel = rootPart:FindFirstChild("FlyVelocity")
				if flyVel then flyVel:Destroy() end

				-- Reset humanoid states
				humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, true)
				humanoid.PlatformStand = false

				-- Send notification
				local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
				if remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Notification") then
					remotes.Notification:FireClient(player, "Info", "Flying disabled")
				end
			end
		end)

		if success then
			table.insert(results, string.format("%s: Fly %s", player.Name, enable and "enabled" or "disabled"))
		else
			table.insert(results, string.format("%s: Failed (%s)", player.Name, errorMsg or "Unknown error"))
		end
	end

	return table.concat(results, "\n")
end

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

return function(context, players: {Player}, speed: number)
	speed = math.clamp(speed, 0, 500)

	local results = {}

	for _, player in ipairs(players) do
		local success, errorMsg = pcall(function()
			local character = player.Character
			if not character then
				error("No character")
				return
			end

			local humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
			if not humanoid then
				error("No humanoid")
				return
			end

			humanoid.WalkSpeed = speed

			ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Notification:FireClient(player, "Success", 
				string.format("Walk speed set to %d", speed))
		end)

		if success then
			table.insert(results, string.format("%s: Speed set to %d", player.Name, speed))
		else
			table.insert(results, string.format("%s: Failed (%s)", player.Name, errorMsg or "Unknown error"))
		end
	end

	return table.concat(results, "\n")
end

local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local PlayerDataModule = require(ServerScriptService.Services.PlayerSetUpService.Modules.PlayerDataModule)
local EnemyModule = require(ServerScriptService.Classes.Enemy)
local SpawnService = require(ServerScriptService.Services.EnemySpawnService.SpawnService)

return function(context, players: {Player}, action: string, lane: number)

	if lane < 1 or lane > 7 then
		return "Invalid lane (must be 1-7)"
	end

	local results = {}
	for _, player in ipairs(players) do
		local playerData = PlayerDataModule.Get(player)

		local success, error = pcall(function()
			if action == "random" then
				SpawnService.SpawnEnemy(player, playerData)
			else
				if RS.Assets.Enemies:FindFirstChild(action) then
					EnemyModule.new(player, action, lane, SpawnService.enemySpawnNetworker)
				else
					error("Invalid enemy name: " .. action)
				end
			end
		end)

		if success then
			table.insert(results, string.format("%s: Success", player.Name))
		else
			table.insert(results, string.format("%s: Failed (%s)", player.Name, error or "Unknown error"))
		end
	end

	return table.concat(results, "\n")
end
